item.title: [Honey's Anime Interview] Eir Aoi on Music, Emotion, and Evolution
item.content:encoded:
For over a decade, Eir Aoi has been one of the defining voices of anime music, captivating fans with her powerful vocals and unforgettable theme songs for some of the medium's most beloved series. Her music has resonated with audiences around the world, earning her a dedicated international following. In this interview, Eir Aoi reflects on how anime stories shape her performances, the evolution of her music after returning from hiatus, and why she's now more determined than ever to challenge expectations and explore new creative directions.

Eir Aoi
Honey-Chan
Interview with Eir Aoi
[gray-hex-decoration]
Welcome, and thank you so much for this interview. First, we'd like to know about your creative process. When you are writing or performing a song for a specific anime series, how does understanding the story, characters, and overall message of that anime influence you, both lyrically and musically?
Whenever I have the opportunity to perform a song for an anime series, I read the scripts or the original source material and try to understand the world, themes, and emotions of the work. I then incorporate those elements into my performance, so the series always has a significant influence on me.
Since your return from hiatus, your musical style seems to have evolved. Can you describe how your experiences during your break might have influenced your recent musical direction, and what new themes or sounds you are most excited about exploring now?
Up until now, I often found myself thinking, “Is this what people want from me?” or “Is this the kind of music they're expecting from me?” I was more focused on living up to the image people had of me than on defining myself as an artist. Going forward, I’d like to explore a wider range of musical styles. For example, I’d like to try genres I’ve never performed before, as well as music that people might not typically associate with me. I’m excited to see what shape that will ultimately take, and I hope everyone will look forward to it as well.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o8CkpcpahSE
You recently worked on two OP themes: “MONSTER,” the OP theme of Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester, and “Unrealistic,” the OP theme of That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4. Given the distinct worlds of these two popular anime, what were your individual creative approaches to writing and performing each of these songs to capture the essence of their respective series?
First of all, I’m grateful for the opportunity to perform the theme songs for these series. It’s a real honor to be able to express each work’s world through the songs, whether that’s through the lyrics, the recording process, or the music videos. Having been given this opportunity, I hope to bring that same passion to my live performances going forward.
Your music is gaining traction among the global anime community. How do you feel about your songs reaching such a wide international audience? When you are creating new music, do you consider your international listeners?
I’m truly happy that my music is reaching people around the world through anime. Before I started performing overseas, I never imagined that fans would be singing my songs along with me, so it means a great deal to see audiences joining in. It also makes me very happy to see people connect my music with the anime and immerse themselves in those worlds. When recording new songs, I always try to sing in a way that will resonate with everyone who experiences the work, whether they're in Japan or overseas.
Looking ahead, what is the next musical challenge you are eager to take on? This could involve a collaboration with an artist, experimenting with an entirely new genre, or performing at a venue you have always aspired to.
Lately, I've been wanting to break free from the image people have of me. Instead of making the kind of songs that people naturally associate with Eir Aoi, I'd like to challenge myself with music that goes against those expectations.
That really sounds so cool and exciting! Now I'm really curious about what kind of music Eir Aoi could surprise us with next! If you're curious too, follow her on social media and be the first to enjoy all of her new songs and projects!
Connect with Eir Aoi Official Site: aoieir.jp Official X: x.com/eir_ruru2 Instagram：instagram.com/aoieir TikTok：tiktok.com/@eir_ruru2 YouTube：youtube.com/@eir_ajito Spotify：open.spotify.com/intl-ja/artist/18moNotPmBWa2YZtRnIoZ3 “MONSTER / unrealistic” streaming and download: lnk.to/LACM-24832s

KADOKAWA Launches 2nd English Web Novel Contest to Discover Global Talent: MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2026 - THE HEROIC FANTASY presented by KADOKAWA
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="Illustration by Rei" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • KADOKAWA CORPORATION, in partnership with qdopp Inc. and MyAnimeList Co., Ltd., has announced MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2026 - THE HEROIC FANTASY presented by KADOKAWA. This English-language fantasy contest will be hosted on Honeyfeed, a novel submission platform operated by qdopp, with the goal of discovering talented authors from around the world.

    • About MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2026 - THE HEROIC FANTASY presented by KADOKAWA

    Contest Webpage: mhwc.myanimelist.net/202607 KADOKAWA is seeking submissions across two distinct themes: Epic Heroine and Tragic Hero. For Epic Heroine, we are looking for stories in the vein of Secrets of the Silent Witch, featuring a female protagonist whose overwhelming strength contrasts with her endearing “flaws”. For Tragic Hero, we want gripping tales akin to Sentenced to Be a Hero, following a male protagonist who makes a comeback rising from the depths of despair. Either way, the absolute baseline for a winning entry is a compelling protagonist. We want stories centered on characters who will thrill fantasy fans around the globe.

    Prizes

    (Please refer to the submission guidelines for full details) Grand Prize (1 winner per theme, 2 winners total): $5,000 USD Runner-Up Prize (Awarded only if no Grand Prize is selected): $3,000 USD Grand Prize-winning novels will be assigned both an editor from KADOKAWA and a professional Japanese light novel author, who will work with the winner to revise the manuscript for publication in Japan. Novels awarded a Runner-Up Prize might also be offered publication through KADOKAWA upon revisal. Subject to KADOKAWA’s final approval, selected novels will be adapted into Japanese, illustrated by a professional light novel artist, and published in Japan as a light novel with a target release in the 2028 fiscal year (subject to change).

    Submission Period

    ・July 6, 2026, 5:00 PM PDT – September 27, 2026, 9:00 PM (PDT)

    How to Enter

    (Please refer to the submission guidelines for full details) To participate, create and publish a new, original English-language web novel on Honeyfeed. Entries must be updated with regular chapter releases, reach a satisfying story conclusion, and achieve a minimum total word count of 50,000 words by September 27, 2026, at 9:00 PM (PDT).

    Background & Objectives

    This contest is organized as part of KADOKAWA’s Global UGC Publishing Project, a new initiative aiming to grant storytellers from around the world the opportunity to be published in Japan and break into the Japanese light novel market. It marks the second edition of our English-language web novel contest, following the success of the inaugural MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2025 – THE ISEKAI presented by KADOKAWA. In last year’s contest, one outstanding work was awarded the Grand Prize, while two exceptional entries received Contest Winners Prizes.

    About KADOKAWA’s Global UGC Publishing Project

    In recent years, Japanese anime has surged in popularity worldwide, with many hit titles originating from light novels. In parallel, international online writing platforms have seen a growing number of original works heavily influenced by Japanese light novels, turning these sites into fertile ground for creators with genuine global potential. Against this backdrop, KADOKAWA launched the Global UGC Publishing Project as part of its Global Business Acceleration Program, which supports new overseas-oriented business initiatives. Through this project, KADOKAWA aims to discover talented new storytellers from around the world, through global web novel platform story submissions. By publishing these internationally created light novels in Japan and around the world, KADOKAWA aims to pioneer the next generation of global hit franchises.

item.title: MyAnimeList × Honeyfeed Web Novel Contest 2025 Winners Announced: Three Titles Chosen by Global Fans!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Frontier Works Inc. (President: Masahide Tsuji; Headquarters: Itabashi, Tokyo) has announced the winning titles for the “MyAnimeList × Honeyfeed Web Novel Contest 2025 - Twilight Frontiers presented by Frontier Works,” co-hosted with MyAnimeList, the world’s largest anime and manga community, and Honeyfeed, a web novel platform with a strong following among overseas light novel fans.
  • Following a comprehensive judging process and enthusiastic voting by readers around the world, three outstanding works have been selected. To support and encourage the authors in their future creative endeavors, each winner will receive a prize of USD 3,000
  • Keep a close eye on this next generation of indie authors as they take their next steps onto the global stage!

    • Award-Winning Titles

    Urban Fantasy Category Title: The Pale Horseman Author: Gemini Daydream Synopsis: Why did the Rider of Death possess a struggling journalist? In a Tokyo where magical relics and technology collide, Death watches the absurd demise of humanity. A ruthless god of death and an idealistic girl make the worst possible duo, yet together they confront the darkest corners of modern society. A fresh, gripping fantasy that cuts through the truth of the world with a sharp, cynical lens. Spotlight Romance Category Title: Miss Kagayaki: Won’t the Ice Princess of K-Pop's Childhood Friend Deem Her Worthy?! Author: obliviousbushtit Synopsis: Global megastar Kagayaki makes a shocking transfer to a local high school. Wearing the flawless mask of the “Ice Princess,” her true goal is to reunite with her childhood friend and rival, Riku. However, a hellish, agency-orchestrated “fake rivalry” awaits her. As their fates collide on a stage built of lies, a high-stakes youth survival story begins, with absolutely no escape. Judges’ Special Award (Urban Fantasy) Title: Intercity Excursions Author: ennodaye Synopsis: Pisha, an immortal girl who longs for death, is forcefully conscripted into I.E., a special unit that hunts individuals with supernatural abilities. Despite her desire to die, she is swept up by the organization’s dark secrets and the looming shadow of the terrorist group Moroya, forcing her to question the very meaning of her existence. What lies at the end of despair for a girl killed and resurrected time and over again? A shocking, high-octane action thriller of blood, gunpowder, cruel fate, and deep internal conflict.

    Contest Overview

    Title: MyAnimeList × Honeyfeed Web Novel Contest 2025 - Twilight Frontiers presented by Frontier Works Results Announcement: June 24, 2026 Official Contest Webpage: mhwc.myanimelist.net/202510
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    * The images shown above are for illustrative purposes and use cover artwork from titles our company publishes for the English-language market. As the winning works have not yet been published, official cover illustrations are not yet available.

item.title: Ginger Root and Luna Goami to Release Theme Songs for Kyoto Animation’s New Anime Sparks of Tomorrow
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • The opening and ending themes for the upcoming TV anime Sparks of Tomorrow are officially set for global digital release. The opening theme by Luna Goami will drop on July 6, followed by the ending theme from Ginger Root on July 13 across all major music streaming and download platforms.
  • Sparks of Tomorrow is the latest TV anime from the renowned studio Kyoto Animation. Set in an alternate-history, early 20th-century Kyoto where steam power reigns supreme, this adventure tale follows the chance meeting of a boy obsessed with the “age of electricity” and an earnest young girl living with the memory of her late mother. The series premieres on July 5, 2026, airing on Japanese television and streaming globally exclusively on Netflix.
  • The opening theme is performed by multi-talented singer and lyricist Luna Goami, known for her vocal work on hit titles like The Apothecary Diaries and the blockbuster film Last Mile. Handling the ending theme is Southern California indie-pop artist Ginger Root, whose breakout track “Loretta” has amassed over 48 million streams. Sparks of Tomorrow marks the first official anime theme song project for both artists.
  • The opening theme “Eureka Evrika” is composed by Hitomi Koto, who also handles the series’ soundtrack, with lyrics written by Luna Goami herself. The track masterfully pairs driving percussion with soaring strings to capture the high-octane energy of the upcoming adventure.
    • https://youtu.be/7ObipYqbOd8
  • Details for the ending theme by Ginger Root have also been revealed. Titled “Soarin’,” the track was written, composed, and arranged entirely by the artist himself. The song opens with a melancholic intro reminiscent of approaching storm clouds, before giving way to rhythmic percussion that effortlessly drives the story forward.
    • https://youtu.be/5rQWh9aIflw

    Comment from Luna Goami

    Sometimes reality surpasses our dreams. That is exactly how I felt when I was chosen to perform the opening theme for Kyoto Animation, a studio I deeply love. I immersed myself in the background materials and the script, letting Hitomi Koto’s soundscapes and the director’s vision guide my creative process. The song itself is vibrant and wondrous, yet driven by a powerful momentum. Keeping the core themes of “belief” and “doubt” in mind, I strolled through the streets of Kyoto to find the right words to capture this unique universe. The moment the invented phrase “Eureka Evrika” came to me, it felt like a literal lightbulb switching on in my mind. This is a story of rebirth and the sparkle of life. Because I was pregnant during the production, there were challenging moments, but it filled me with a profound happiness that I poured entirely into the track. I can’t wait to share this music and story with everyone!

    Comment from Ginger Root

    The day is finally here for everyone to hear my very first anime ending theme! Words can’t describe how incredible it feels to take this on. As a massive otaku myself, I still can’t quite believe I got to make a real anime song! The title of the track is “Soarin’.” Flying through the sky is something regular humans can’t actually do, right? But if you push yourself as hard as you can, don’t you feel like it’s within reach? Inspired by the themes of the anime, I chose this title to capture that exact feeling: if you chase your dreams, absolutely anything is possible! I’m just as excited as all of you to watch the premiere!

    Distribution Information

    “Eureka Evrika” by Luna Goami Release Date: July 6, 2026 Pre-add/Pre-save: lnk.to/LZC-3564 “Soarin’” by Ginger Root Release Date: July 13, 2026 Pre-add/Pre-save: lnk.to/LZC-3567
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    Luna Goami Profile

    A versatile singer and lyricist celebrated for her expressive vocal range in film scores and insert songs. Her work, including lyric and vocal contributions to titles such as the anime The Apothecary Diaries and Mr. Osomatsu and the hit Japanese drama Dearest, has attracted attention, particularly for her distinctive singing voice. Described as possessing a voice that blends pristine clarity with a thrilling edge, her signature style includes melodic improvisation and singing in fictional languages. Because of this unique range, composers and creators highly praise her ability to completely capture and embody the world of any project she works on. Her theatrical repertoire includes vocal performances for stage music productions such as Demon Slayer and Shoujo YoRHa (set in the world of NieR:Automata). In 2021, her work on the theme song and score for Hide & Sniff earned a nomination for Best Original Score at the Nice International Film Festival in France. While personally handling everything from songwriting to design work, she continues to constantly explore and push the boundaries of vocal expression. Website & Social Media Official Website: lunagoami.com Youtube: youtube.com/@lunagoami X: x.com/Luna_Goami Instagram: instagram.com/lunagoami
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    Ginger Root Profile

    Ginger Root is a solo project by Cameron Lew, a Southern California-based multi-instrumentalist, producer, songwriter, and visual artist. He launched the project in earnest in 2017 during his college years, making waves with a distinct sound described as “aggressive elevator soul” and gaining traction through popular cover videos on YouTube. Handling everything from songwriting and recording to mixing and mastering himself, Lew also draws on his film-school background to craft all of his own art and music videos from scratch. He released his debut album Mahjong Room in 2018, followed by Rikki in 2020, and the Japanese culture-inspired EP City Slicker in 2021. Ginger Root’s popularity has skyrocketed in Japan, where his four-show tour in January 2023 completely sold out. Proving his massive draw, he followed it up with a massive six-date Zepp tour across Japan in support of his latest album, SHINBANGUMI. Website & Social Media Official Website: gingerrootmusic.com Youtube: youtube.com/@GingerRootMusic X: x.com/gingerrootmusic Instagram: instagram.com/gingerrootmusic

item.title: Rico Sasaki Releases Full-Length Album RI PATHOS; Music Video for Lead Track “Touri Seikei” Unveiled
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • On June 3, 2026, singer and voice actress Rico Sasaki released her full-length album RI PATHOS. Featuring ten all-new songs exploring diverse personal themes, the album reflects her journey to date and the future she is moving toward as an artist.
  • Coinciding with the launch, the music video for the lead track, “Touri Seikei,” has been unveiled. The song introduces a heavy hardcore sound, composed and arranged by Nodobue Tanaka of the band “the bercedes menz,” a group deeply rooted in the genre.
  • “Touri Seikei” draws its name from a classical Chinese idiom conveying that people naturally gather around those of sincerity and virtue. The track reinterprets this ancient proverb through a modern lens, presenting Sasaki’s own take on the concept—one where people are drawn together not by words or self-promotion, but by the quiet integrity of how one lives.
  • The accompanying music video portrays the journey of life through the imagery of branching plants, illustrating how setbacks and inner struggles can serve as a foundation for personal growth. Projected through the motif of winter trees, the visuals capture a fleeting yet resilient vitality, evoking the image of an artist who continues to stand tall through adversity.
  • Experience this powerful new music video alongside the official release of RI PATHOS.
    • https://youtu.be/LxbEOTl_MOc RI PATHOS on Music and Streaming Platforms lnk.to/LACA-25275d

    Comment from Rico Sasaki

    When recording “Touri Seikei,” I wanted to sing about more than just chasing a dream. I wanted to embrace the real-world pain discovered along the way, as well as my own imperfections. Even if things don’t work out exactly the way you envisioned, it doesn’t mean the dream was meaningless. I want to believe that even a decayed dream can become nourishment for the next one. I poured my heart into this track with the hope that the path I’ve walked will, someday, connect with someone else’s journey. In the music video, I hope viewers can feel the quiet resolve that lies beyond that inner struggle, alongside the dignified, resilient vitality that defines this song.

    Born November 10 Akita Prefecture Rico Sasaki loved music and singing from a young age and grew up surrounded by various musical influences. This led to an awakening in singing and acting, and she enrolled in a high school with a specialized music program, where she majored in vocal music. Despite her petite stature, her voice resonates with a soulful quality that surprises many. She is also currently active as a voice actress. item.title: [리뷰] 친구와 함께라면 귀신도 안무섭다. 협동 유적 탐험 게임 ‘초자연 작전팀’
[Honey's Anime Interview] ZAQ's “Liar Veil” and the Art of Anime Composition
item.content:encoded:
For years, ZAQ has been one of the most distinctive voices in anime music, known for bringing emotional intensity and sharp storytelling to every song she creates. From explosive anthems to more layered and introspective tracks like “Liar Veil,” her music always reflects a deep understanding of the stories behind the anime she works on. In our first interview with ZAQ, we spoke with her about her creative process, the emotions behind her latest single, and her thoughts on connecting with fans around the world. Read on to learn more about the ideas and passion that shape her music!

ZAQ
Honey-Chan
Interview with ZAQ
[gray-hex-decoration]
Helo ZAQ, and thank you very much for the opportunity to talk about your powerful theme songs to numerous popular anime. When composing a song for an anime series, what are the most crucial elements you focus on to ensure your music perfectly captures the spirit and narrative of the show?
When I start a project, I first read the original manga or script very carefully. I don’t just look at the story, but also explore the emotions the characters are hiding, the sense of ethics running through the work, the rhythm of the dialogue, and even the meaning behind the moments of silence. I want to understand what it is trying to tell the audience. In anime songs, respect for the work comes through in the music. Viewers are very sensitive and can really pick up on that. That’s why I don’t let it end with my own desire for expression. I keep thinking about how it will reach the people who love the work.
Your latest single, "Liar Veil," delves into duality and self-deception. Could you share the central inspiration for the track, and explain how you merged these lyrical concepts with the musical arrangement?
In my previous ZAQ tracks, I often brought explosive impulses to the forefront, but “Liar Veil” is the opposite, expressing the conflicted emotions of the anime’s heroines. On the sound side, I put a lot of thought into how to translate those inner, tangled emotions into music. I aimed for a texture that feels cool and refined on the surface, yet with a constant sense of dissonance underneath. It’s a moody sound that blends lo-fi hip-hop with jazz, and I think it captures the atmosphere of emotionally unstable, alluring women.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jl7GmJBNxk4
As a singer, songwriter, and composer, you are highly involved in every aspect of your music's creation. Can you walk us through your typical creative process, from the initial spark of an idea to the final arrangement?
When thinking about the kind of song I want to create, if it’s going to be a piece with a strong message, I start with the lyrics. I first decide on the keywords or a title, then connect the lyrics together like a patchwork, adjusting them until they form a coherent whole. When a melody doesn’t come to mind, I start with the arrangement instead, and later add a melody that fits the chords and arrangement. I don’t really follow a fixed routine, so I just move forward with the process in whatever order ideas come to me.
With an ever-increasing international fanbase, do you have any plans for live performances overseas?
Many! I want to keep sharing the greatness of Japanese anime songs and the beauty of the Japanese language.
What kind of artistic challenges or new sounds are you most interested in exploring in the future?
Instead of limiting my music to genres like “anime song” or “rock music,” I want to use any sound that’s necessary to tell the story. So I want to stay receptive at all times and continue exploring a wide range of music.
A big thank you to ZAQ for taking the time to speak with us! We’re excited to see where her music goes next, and we hope fans continue supporting her future projects and releases. Go stalk her socials for more amazing songs!

item.title: ASH DA HERO Performed Their First-Ever European Show at Animefest 2026 in the Czech Republic
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    ASH DA HERO appeared at Animefest 2026 in Brno, Czech Republic on May 23, delivering their first-ever European performance. In front of a packed local audience, the band performed 12 songs plus an encore, creating overwhelming excitement that transcended language barriers. ASH DA HERO took the stage at the large-scale anime convention Animefest 2026, held in Brno, Czech Republic on May 23. The venue was the main stage of the Brno Exhibition Centre. At this event, where local fans gathered around their shared love of Japanese anime, manga, games, and cosplay, ASH DA HERO delivered their first performance in Europe. Crossing borders and language barriers alike, the band captivated the audience purely through the raw energy of their music. Even before the show began, the venue was filled with anticipation from fans eager to see a Japanese rock band live. Some audience members were singing along to Japanese lyrics, some had discovered the band through anime, and others were experiencing ASH DA HERO for the very first time. As the opening SE “Super Sonic” echoed through the hall, the focused anticipation instantly transformed into loud cheers. The first song, “YELLOW FEVER DANCE,” immediately ignited the room the moment ASH’s voice rang out. Sato’s grooving basslines, WANI’s tight and powerful drumming, and Dhalsim’s DJ sound combined to vividly present ASH DA HERO’s genre-crossing style of rock, punk, and hip-hop from the very beginning. During “LA VIDA LOCA,” even without fully understanding every lyric, the audience naturally moved together with the beat and energy. The sound connected, the heat spread, and little by little the entire hall became absorbed into ASH DA HERO’s rhythm. One of the early highlights was “MANIFESTO.” The fierce sound and ASH’s sharp vocals collided head-on, sending the stage’s intensity directly into the crowd. Even though the lyrics were in Japanese, the determination, conviction, and forward-driving spirit embedded in the songs clearly reached the audience. More fists rose into the air with each song, and the cheers only grew louder. There was no sense of distance usually associated with an “overseas performance” — only a powerful unity created by people sharing the same music at the same moment. During the first MC, ASH greeted the local crowd using some Czech phrases. Even though the words were not perfect, the sincere effort to communicate in the audience’s own language immediately brought the stage and crowd closer together. At that moment, the barrier of language visibly began to disappear.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    Midway through the set, the band also performed songs perfectly suited for an anime convention setting. Their covers of FLOW’s “GO!!!” and Hironobu Kageyama’s “CHA-LA HEAD-CHA-LA” sparked huge reactions throughout the venue. Hearing iconic anime songs performed through ASH DA HERO’s unique filter pushed the crowd’s excitement even further. It was a scene that could only happen at Animefest — Japanese anime songs being celebrated passionately by fans in the Czech Republic. As the second half of the show unfolded, the stage grew even more intense. The band performed “Harmonics,” originally featured in That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie, followed by “BELIEVERS,” the opening theme song for the currently airing TV anime Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2. The song’s themes of overcoming inferiority and inner conflict resonated deeply with the audience beyond the context of an anime tie-in. Every time ASH’s voice soared powerfully across the venue, the crowd answered with massive cheers, making the emotional impact of the songs even stronger. With “Octave” and “Beast Mode,” the band fully unleashed their aggressive live-band energy. The low-end groove and explosive stage performance drove the audience into an even greater frenzy. Then came “Judgement,” a song that likely connected especially strongly with fans who discovered ASH DA HERO through the TV anime Blue Lock. In that moment, the venue reached one of its biggest peaks of excitement. Far away from Japan, in the Czech Republic, the connection between anime and music had undeniably taken shape right before everyone’s eyes. In a later MC, ASH spoke sincerely about how the world today cannot necessarily be called peaceful, yet emphasized the band’s desire to continue shouting messages of love and peace through music. Those words quietly but powerfully reached everyone in the venue regardless of nationality, language, or culture. Carrying that message forward, the band then performed the English version of “Everything.” After building excitement primarily through Japanese-language songs, this moment became one of the symbolic highlights of the night — not only transcending language barriers, but actively using language to connect even more deeply with the audience. The final song of the main set was “PARADE.” It transformed all the accumulated energy of the night into a celebration, fully uniting the stage and audience as one. Despite being ASH DA HERO’s very first European show, there was no feeling of unfamiliarity — only the sense that everyone already shared the same passion. When the song ended, loud “ASH DA HERO” chants erupted throughout the hall as the band temporarily left the stage. Even after the members disappeared backstage, the chants continued nonstop. Responding to the audience’s passion, the band returned for an encore performance of one of their signature songs, “Judgement.” As the explosive sound rang out one final time, the venue’s excitement reached its absolute peak. The encore symbolized how wholeheartedly the Czech audience had embraced ASH DA HERO. What ASH DA HERO left behind in the Czech Republic that night was more than simply a successful overseas performance. It was proof that Japanese rock music, with anime culture as a gateway, can truly move people’s hearts beyond both language and distance. Their performance at Animefest 2026 marked a major first step into Europe — and the echoes of that night in Brno strongly suggested an even bigger future ahead for ASH DA HERO worldwide.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    Setlist

    SE. Super Sonic M1. YELLOW FEVER DANCE M2. LA VIDA LOCA M3. MANIFESTO MC M4. GO!!! (cover) M5. CHA-LA HEAD-CHA-LA (1cho cover) MC M6. Harmonics (NEW) M7. BELIEVERS M8. Octave M9. Beast Mode M10. Judgement MC M11. Everything (ENG ver.) M12. PARADE EN. Judgement

    Release Information

    ASH DA HERO 3rd Single "BELIEVERS" is now available on various music streaming services! Click here for various music streaming services: lnk.to/ADH_BELIEVERSPR youtu.be/tAbbeN47Ttk

    Profile

    Formed in September 2021. Their must-see live performance is delivered by the overwhelming vocalist ASH, whose music is rooted in ROCK, PUNK, and HIP HOP and expressed through a chameleonic style, along with the distinct individuality and presence of Sato (Ba.), WANI (Dr.), and Dhalsim (DJ). They are a one-of-a-kind mixture band where the four members' talents and roots miraculously intersect.Formed in September 2021. They are a one-of-a-kind mixture band where the four members' talents and roots miraculously intersect. item.title: Aria the Natural and Aria the Origination - Two More Soundtracks to Be Released on Vinyl!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

  • The ever-popular anime series Aria celebrated its 20th anniversary in 2025 and continues to be loved to this day. A second installment of vinyl soundtrack releases for Aria has been announced. The soundtracks for the second and third parts of the series, Aria The Natural and Aria The Origination, are scheduled to be released September 2, 2026. Both covers will feature the same original artwork from the CD release, making these items a must-have for Aria fans wanting to relive the excitement from the show’s broadcast.
  • First edition copies of the soundtrack for Aria The Natural will be pressed on dark blue and red clear vinyls, reminiscent of the Aria Company and Himeya’s colors, while first edition copies of the soundtrack for Aria the Origination will be pressed on lime yellow and orange clear vinyls, reminiscent of Orange Planet’s color and Neo Venezia’s sunset featured on the original CD jacket.
  • In addition, first editions of Aria The Origination Original Soundtrack Tre -vinyl edition- will come with a special storage box featuring an original illustration drawn by Kozue Amano. The illustration depicts a room where the sunlight of Neo Venezia streams through the curtains, casting a beautiful glow. Akari Mizunashi stands with her back to the window with President Aria next to her. Their gazes are directed at the viewer, creating a striking image that envelopes the viewer in a soothing silence. The storage box can hold up to three records, perfect for storing all three vinyl releases of the Aria soundtracks, so don’t forget to check out Aria The Animation Original Soundtrack Vinyl Edition as well.

item.title: [리뷰] "완벽하게 부활한 젊은 본드" ‘007 퍼스트 라이트’
Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex and Innocence - Five Series Albums and One OST to Be Released on Vinyl!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex aired in 2002 on SKY Perfect Choice network for two seasons, with a total of 52 episodes. The popular series directed by Kenji Kamiyama, produced by Production I.G with music by Yoko Kanno was not only a huge hit in Japan, but saw great success overseas, topping the ratings on cable television across the United States.
  • The fusion of “starkness and lyricism” that characterizes Yoko Kanno’s music paints a picture of a cyberpunk world in the not-so-far off future. It blends digital electronica with echoes of eastern European folk songs, jazz, and rock. The vocals feature a blend of languages such as Russian, English and Italian that depicts a stateless and complex future society. The soundtrack has been previously released on five CD albums.
  • With the newest installment in the series The Ghost in the Shell, scheduled to air this July, all five CD albums from Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex will be released on vinyl July 22 and August 26, 2026.
  • The original soundtrack for the 2004 OVA Innocence, directed by Mamoru Oishii with music produced by Kenji Kawai, will also be released on vinyl August 26, 2026.
  • In commemoration of the upcoming analog release of these titles, 14 total songs will be selected from the soundtrack and uploaded weekly on FlyingDog’s official YouTube channel, with the first track having been uploaded today. Fans, and those unfamiliar with the series alike, can appreciate this opportunity to experience the musical world of Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex.

    The 2004 OVA by Mamoru Oishii also known as Ghost in the Shell 2: Innocence. Set in Japan in the year 2032, the story follows Batou, a cyborg from Section 9, as he investigates a series of incidents involving malfunctioning female sex-bots (gynoids.) Set three years after the events of its predecessor Ghost in the Shell, it was the first animated Japanese film to be selected for the official competition at the Cannes Film Festival. The album features 12 total tracks, including powerful performances of “Kugutsu Uta” (Making of Cyborg) by 70 folk singers from Nishida Shachu, a composition that captures the sound of a giant music box, and the theme song “Follow Me” by Kimiko Ito. item.title: An Official Visualizer for “See You Soon” by SEKAI NO OWARI’s Nakajin Has Been Released!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • An official visualizer for “See U Soon,” the latest track from the solo project of Nakajin, a member of SEKAI NO OWARI, was released today.
  • The video, released today, was produced by Grey93 Studios, a prominent creative studio known for producing stage visuals for Travis Scott’s Astroworld as well as handling creative direction for the official Cactus Jack Instagram account.
  • Set against the backdrop of a city at night, the video captures a rider speeding down the highway as they gradually become aware of the presence of “another existence.” As the story reaches its climax, the city’s lights and colors begin to dissolve, creating an intoxicating visual world where the line between reality and sensation becomes increasingly blurred. The work powerfully brings to life the theme of “See U Soon,” meaning “we’ll meet again soon,” while visually embodying the song’s exhilarating sense of speed and euphoria.
  • The track also features a collaboration with Skylar Mones, a Grammy-winning LA-based producer and songwriter known for his work with Rihanna and Dua Lipa, and Elle Vee, who has crafted top-line melodies for numerous hits in the EDM scene. Centered on the thrilling dynamic of “chase and escape,” the track depicts two people drawn together by a powerful, inexplicable chemistry—a force of attraction that defies logic. Paired with a high-energy dance/EDM sound, it constructs a dramatic world where tension and exhilaration intertwine.
  • Born from a resonance with global creators, this track marks the beginning of a new phase for Nakajin.
  • Having led SEKAI NO OWARI to numerous hits and successful large-scale live shows and tours in and outside of Japan, Nakajin continues to expand his creativity through his solo project. His evolving artistic expression, shaped by collaborations with artists both in Japan and abroad, has generated high expectations for his future endeavors.
  • Stay tuned for Nakajin’s upcoming activities, as a diverse lineup of releases is scheduled for 2026.
    • https://youtu.be/j_Mi2iilxGI

    Release information

    “See U Soon” - Nakajin, Elle Vee See U Soon AUDIO VISUALIZER： youtu.be/j_Mi2iilxGI Streaming Links： nakajin.lnk.to/seeusoonPR Produced by Nakajin Lyrics & Music: Nakajin, Elle Vee, Skylar Mones Producers: Nakajin, Skylar Mones

    Grey93 Sudios

    Grey93 Studios is a creative studio specializing in high-impact visual content, animation, and immersive brand storytelling. We work with artists, brands, and cultural organizations to develop distinctive visual experiences ranging from animated music visualizers and campaign assets to large-scale event activations. Skylar Mones Skylar is a dynamic writer and producer whose versatility makes him a great addition to any top-tier pop room, operating fluidly as a producer, songwriter, vocal producer, and executive producer. His track record includes cuts with major global artists such as JLo, Dua Lipa (contributing to the Grammy-winning album Future Nostalgia), Becky G, Sean Kingston, Travis Barker, Flo Rida, Kesha, Carlie Hanson, EXO, Monsta X, and BoA, among many others. Skylar initially built his career as a full-time producer between 2015 and 2019, making a significant impact in Asia with multiple chart-topping JPop and KPop records, accumulating over 100+ major releases in Japan alone and many others in Korea after 2018. He's also Executive Produced for albums by Red Bull recording artist Gavin Haley and The Voice winners Girl Named Tom. Currently, Skylar is working with: James Arthur, MonstaX, Faangs, inverness, Red Velvet, Clean Bandit, and Rita Ora. He is open to new and compelling signings from major labels and collaborations for pitch sessions with hit writers.

    Elle Vee

    By 2025, Elle Vee has accumulated over 800 million spotify streams with her work. The Los Angeles based Recording artist, songwriter, and vocalist specializes in Electronic Dance Music. Her career took off in 2017 with her song "INTO DUST" with Paris Blohm. Other collaborations include Slander, Excision, Kaaze, Nurko, Mitis, Nevve, Ferry Corsten, Flo-Rida, Dbangz. Elle Vee is the real deal, having a huge hand in the creative process on every song she touches, her powerhouse vocal belting, her eloquent way with words, her silky falsetto, and her Collaboration with Slander and Excision "YOUR FAULT" Was a worldwide hit with over 30 million streams. Her vast variety of vocal tones have landed her on big collaborations in all genres all across the board. In 2022, Elle Vee signed a publishing deal with Ultra International Publishing, home to some of the biggest songwriters and producers in the dance/electronic genre, Elle has also had dozen of syncs with Abc, Cbs, nbc, netflix and many others.

    Discography

    Released Wednesday, May 15, 2026 “Satellite” - Nakajin, TRiiiPSS Streaming link: nakajin.lnk.to/satellitePR Released December 12, 2025 “Same Routine (feat. Marcin, Margot Liotta)” - Nakajin Streaming link: nakajin.lnk.to/sameroutinePR Released July 11, 2025 “TOKYO” - Nakajin Streaming link: nakajin.lnk.to/tokyoPR

    About Nakajin

    Producer / DJ / Songwriter / Multi-Instrumentalist Nakajin made his debut as a member of the renowned Japanese band SEKAI NO OWARI. SEKAI NO OWARI, known for their seven original albums, live performances in stadiums and domes, and numerous prestigious awards, has truly become a representative group of Japan. Continuing his musical exploration fueled by curiosity, Nakajin embarked on a new solo project in 2024.

    Nakajin's Discography

    https://youtu.be/tVL4hzhHQYk → Remix for Two Door Cinema Club https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qlgEadao-Sk → ILLIT “Almond Music” Music written by Nakajin

    Nakajin's SNS

    HP: universal-music.co.jp/nakajin YouTube: youtube.com/@NakajinArtist TikTok: tiktok.com/@nakajin_ Instagram : instagram.com/nakajin X: x.com/Nakajin_sekaino

    About SEKAI NO OWARI

    In 2010, the four-piece band “SEKAI NO OWARI” burst onto the music scene. After releasing their first album, “EARTH,” that same year, they made their major-label debut in 2011. With their unique presence, songs ranging from pop to dark, and live performances brimming with a theme-park-like atmosphere, they gained a wide following among listeners of all ages, from children to adults. In 2015, they held a two-day “Twilight City” concert at Nissan Stadium, Japan’s largest venue. In 2021, marking the 10th anniversary of their major-label debut, they released their first-ever greatest hits album. The following year, in 2022, they released “Habit,” which became a sensation primarily on social media, surpassing 2.5 billion views on TikTok. The music video released on YouTube surpassed 200 million views, making it one of the defining songs of 2022 and earning them the Record Award that same year. They also held their first-ever four-major-dome tour, “Du Gara Di Du.” In 2024, their seventh album, “Nautilus,” surpassed the CD sales of their previous album. That same year, they held their largest-scale tour to date, the “ARENA TOUR 2024 ‘Deep Sea’,” featuring 33 shows across 15 venues nationwide, drawing a total audience of approximately 350,000. The year 2026 marks the 15th anniversary of their major-label debut, and they plan to hold a dome tour. SEKAI NO OWARI has become one of Japan’s leading groups in both name and reality. As a trailblazer at the forefront of the music scene, they are a talent that never stops and continues to push forward. item.title: A Complete Collection of Maaya Sakamoto’s Fate/Grand Order Theme Songs to Be Released on July 29!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Currently in the midst of her 30th anniversary as an artist, Maaya Sakamoto continues to lead in multiple roles such as singer, actress, voice actress, lyricist, and essayist. Her 30th anniversary concert, held over the weekend of April 18th and 19th at Tokyo’s Ariake Arena, ended with great acclaim. Now, a new release has just been announced.
  • The new release is titled Yoin. Disc one features all six theme songs from the role-playing game for smartphones Fate/Grand Order, from “Shikisai” that was released alongside the official game launch in 2015 to the theme song of the final chapter that was released in 2025 “Tokei.”
  • “Tokei” was released digitally last year and will be recorded on CD for the first time.
  • Disc two features previously recorded unplugged sessions of “Shikisai” and “Gyakko” as well as a newly recorded unplugged session of “Yakudo.” Additionally, it includes a cover of “Toumei” by Mamoru Miyano, the theme song for the movie Divine Realm Of The Round Table: Camelot Paladin; Agateram, which lyrics were written by Maaya herself.
  • The first-press edition is a deluxe limited edition release that comes with a Blu-ray disc with previously unreleased footage in a three-sided sleeve case featuring an original double-sided illustration by Takashi Takeuchi (TYPE-MOON)!
  • Keep your eyes on Maaya Sakamoto who is more active than ever during her 30th anniversary!

    • Release information

    Artist: Maaya Sakamoto Title: Fate/Grand Order Theme Song Best Album Yoin Date: July 29, 2026 First-press edition 2-CD Blu-ray set VTZL-273 / 4,950 yen (tax in.) The Blu-ray disc includes the music video for “Tokei” and a recording of the Fate/Grand Order 6th Anniversary Special Live ~Maaya Sakamoto Unplugged~, a livestream concert that was held without an audience at Tokyo Opera City in 2021. Standard edition 2-CD set VTCL-60703~60704 / 2,750 yen (tax in.) A complete collection of Maaya Sakamoto’s Fate/Grand Order theme songs from the past 11 years!!

    Product Information

    Disc one features all six theme songs from the role-playing game for smartphones Fate/Grand Order, from “Shikisai” that was released alongside the official game launch in 2015 to the theme song of the final chapter that was released in 2025 “Tokei.” Disc two features previously recorded unplugged sessions of “Shikisai” and “Gyakko” as well as a newly recorded unplugged session of “Yakudo.” Additionally, it includes a cover of “Toumei” by Mamoru Miyano, the theme song for the movie Divine Realm Of The Round Table: Camelot Paladin; Agateram, which lyrics were written by Maaya herself. Yakudo (Fate/Grand Order The Second Chapter part two theme song) 5. Dokuhaku (Fate/Grand Order The Movie Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot: Wandering; Agateram) 6. Tokei (Fate/Grand Order The Final Chapter theme song) Disc 2: 1. Shikisai -unplugged session- 2. Gyakko -unplugged session- 3. Yakudo -unplugged session- 4. Yakudo Featuring Maaya Sakamoto, Kento Ohgiya, Masao Fukunaga, Ichiro Fujiya, Kazuma Sotozono, and Kouichiro Muroya. “Tokei” Music Video

    Streaming Information

    Available on select music streaming services and major music download platforms such as iTunes Store, Rekochoku and mora July 29, 2026! Streaming services: Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, LINE MUSIC, Amazon Music, Deezer, AWA, Rakuten Music, KKBOX, and Qobuz. Watch the music video on Apple Music, YouTube Music, LINE MUSIC, and U-NEXT.

    About Maaya Sakamoto

    Born in Tokyo, she began her career as a child actress at the age of eight. She made her CD debut in 1996 with the single “Yakusoku wa Iranai.” Following her 2011 album You Can’t Catch Me, which topped the Oricon chart, she began actively collaborating with a wide range of other artists and musicians. Since her 2013 album Singer-Songwriter, she has also been composing music for other artists. In 2019, she released her 30th single “Uchuu no Kioku” (produced by Ringo Sheena) and her 10th original album Kyou Dake no Ongaku. In 2020, she released her 25th anniversary album Single Collection+ Achikochi and the digital single “Yakudo,” which topped the Oricon chart. In July 2021, her radio program “Vitamin M,” which she had been hosting for 20 years, reached its 1,000th broadcast and entered its 21st year. In May 2022, she released the double tie-up single “Sumire / Kotoba ni Dekinai,” with music written and arranged by Shigeru Kishida. Her latest digital single “Tokei” was released in December of 2025 as the theme song for the final chapter of the Fate/Grand Order series. She’s released 36 singles and 11 full albums to date. In addition to writing her own original songs, she has also written lyrics for other artists, including Kinki Kids’ “Hikari no Kehai,” Mamoru Miyano’s “Toumei,” and Walküre’s “Kaze wa Yokoku Naku Fuku,” and has published her own lyrics book Shishu (Kadokawa). She won the 38th Kazuo Kikuta Theater Award for her performance as Jerusha in the musical Daddy-Long-Legs. As of December 12, she is currently appearing in the latest production of Daddy-Long-Legs at Hibiya Theatre Crea as Jerusha for the first time in five years. Her latest essay collection Manpukuron - Asu ni Kaburitsuke (Kadokawa) has also garnered attention. In addition to her singing career, she is active as a voice actress, actress, lyricist, essayist, and radio personality. Her fresh and vibrant voice is loved by fans not only in Japan but also around the world. Nao Toyama’s New Album, OVER THE RAINBOW, Goes on Sale October 7!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Voice actress and singer Nao Toyama held her “Nao Toyama Project 2026 kickoff event ~Iku ze! Budokan!!~” on Sunday, May 3 at Culttz Kawasaki where she announced her fourth full-length album OVER THE RAINBOW will be released October 7, 2026. Her last full-length album, Welcome to MY WONDERLAND, was released four years ago in September 2022.
  • This album will be Toyama’s last before her upcoming hiatus from singing. In it, she describes her career up until now as a “rainbow” and looks forward to moving beyond it, as the title suggests, while expressing gratitude towards her supporters and hope. The tracklist will be the same across all editions featuring 12 songs in total, including new tracks based on the seven colors of the rainbow, four anime theme songs making their album debut, and an original song written and composed by Toyama herself.
  • The album will come in four editions: first press limited edition A, first press limited edition B, standard edition, and the Animate exclusive complete set. The first press limited edition A album includes a bonus Blu-ray featuring the main stage performance of Nao Toyama’s 2026 solo concert “Matsuri”. The first press limited edition B album includes a bonus collaboration CD featuring a star-studded lineup of guest artists. The standard edition is a standard release designed to let fans enjoy the album to its fullest.
  • Furthermore, the Animate exclusive complete set comes with the full album, bonus collaboration CD, bonus Blu-ray featuring the solo concert and encore of “Matsuri”, and a special plush toy of “Sitting Mochibou-chan”.
  • This project is being launched to mark the 10th anniversary of her career, so please stay tuned for further updates.
    • Nao Toyama’s 4th full-length album OVER THE RAINBOW official website: jvcmusic.co.jp/flyingdog/toyamanao/10th/OVER_THE_RAINBOW

    Nao Toyama's Profile

    Birthday: March 11 Blood Type: A Hometown: Tokyo Hobbies: Singing, dancing, playing the electric organ Nao Toyama made her voice acting debut in 2010. She attracted a lot of attention for her role as Kanon Nakagawa in the TV anime The World God Only Knows. After that, she went on to play characters in numerous popular works, such as Karen Kujo in Kin-iro Mosaic, Chitoge Kirisaki in Nisekoi, Reina Prowler in MacrossΔ, and Rin Shima in Yuru CampΔ. She also belongs to popular groups Rhodanthe* and Walküre, both of which were born in anime, and has enthralled fans with her clear voice and flawless performances. On February 1, 2017, she made her debut as a singer with “True Destiny/Chain the world,” tie-up songs for the anime Chain Chronicle: Haecceitas no Hikari, and on February 3, 2018, she held her first solo live at the Nippon Budokan. In 2019, she held her first solo tour and performed overseas in Taipei and Shanghai. In 2020, she celebrated her 10th anniversary as a voice actress by releasing her character song best album “Special Thanks” and holding a 10th anniversary concert titled “Special Thanks! Festival” at Tokyo Garden Theater. In 2022, she celebrated the 5th anniversary of her singing debut with five projects. On February 22, 2025, she held her solo live concert “Watashi no Kangaeta Muteki na Setlist!” Social Media Official X (formerly Twitter): @naobou_official Line account search ID: toyamanao Artist homepage: toyamanao.com Official blog: ameblo.jp/naobouofficial Official YouTube channel: youtube.com/c/naobou_channel Instagram: @naobou_official TikTok account: tiktok.com/@official_naotoyama

TV Anime Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo Opening Theme Song “Komorebizaka”, by Galileo Galilei, CD Single Announcement and Jacket Illustration Reveal!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="booklove-anime.jp" url="booklove-anime.jp" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • TV anime Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo began airing April 9, 2026. The manga was first serialized in Shogakukan’s monthly shonen manga magazine Gessan and has since won the U-NEXT award for the 2022 Next Manga Awards, been ranked first by multiple bookstores for manga recommended by staff in 2023, and been received enthusiastically by professional buyers. The story is a homely comedy that centers around an encounter between first-year middle school student Arata Kouda and Kujima, a strange creature that crossed over to Japan from Russia. This fateful encounter triggers a gradual change within his household.
  • It has been announced that “Komorebizaka” by Galileo Galilei, the opening theme song, will be released as a single. The titular track was written specifically to serve as the opening theme song for the anime after a heartfelt request by the author Akira Konno. In conclusion, a miraculous song was born from the mutual respect between Galileo Galilei and the author. In addition, the tracklist for the CD single, which includes the anime insert song “Hito wa Wataridori”, has also been revealed.
  • The CD jacket illustration is an original illustration by the author. It features Kujima standing alone amidst the swaying grass by the water’s edge as migrating birds fly across the sky. This one-of-a-kind illustration perfectly captures the beautiful and emotional atmosphere of the music. You don’t want to miss out on this rare piece from Galileo Galilei and Akira Konno.
    • https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7ETgAcnUcro

    Product Information

    Komorebizaka by Galileo Galilei Date: June 24, 2026 Price: 1,320 yen (tax in.) / VTCL-35394 Tracklist 1. Komorebizaka 2. Hito wa Wataridori 3. Komorebizaka -Instrumental- 4. Hito wa Wataridori -Instrumental-

    About Galileo Galilei

    Yuuki Ozaki (vocals, guitar) and Kazuki Ozaki (drums) formed the rock band in 2007 in Wakkanai, Hokkaido. In 2008, they won the Senko Riot grand prix and made their major debut in 2010 with their first mini album Hamanasu no Hana. Their transparent melodies and delicate lyrics have gathered support from fans around the world. After their debut, they released numerous hits such as “Natsuzora” (OP theme song for Big Windup! 2) and “Aoi Shiori” (OP theme song for Ano Hana: The Flower We Saw). Following their concert at the Nippon Budokan in 2016, they went on hiatus but have since resumed activities as of October 2022 with a new lineup featuring Yuuki Ozaki, Kazuki Ozaki, Masaki Okazaki (bass) and original founding member Fumito Iwai (guitar). On March 15, 2025, they held a concert at Tokyo Garden Theatre celebrating their 15th anniversary. On October 11, 2025, the guitarist DAIKI, who had been an active member in Bird Bear Hare and Fish (BBHF) alongside Yuuki and Kazuki and had served as a support guitarist for Galileo Galilei, officially joined the band. They released “Amadeus”, the OP theme song for TV anime Ao no Orchestra Season 2, that same month. Galileo Galilei Tour 2026 NAKED HERO, their nationwide tour taking them across seven cities in Japan, kicks off in May 2026. TV anime Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo Original Soundtrack Hororo Shoyo, composed by Manami Kakudo, to be released!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="booklove-anime.jp" url="booklove-anime.jp" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • TV anime Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo began airing April 9, 2026. The manga was first serialized in Shogakukan’s monthly shonen manga magazine Gessan and has since won the U-NEXT award for the 2022 Next Manga Awards, been ranked first by multiple bookstores for manga recommended by staff in 2023, and been received enthusiastically by professional buyers. The story is a homely comedy that centers around an encounter between first-year middle school student Arata Kouda and Kujima, a strange creature that crossed over to Japan from Russia. This fateful encounter triggers a gradual change within his household.
  • The original soundtrack album compiling the series’ distinctive yet mysteriously nostalgic musical score will be released on June 24 and composed by musician and percussionist Manami Kakudo. This marks her first TV anime soundtrack release. Born from her rich talent and avant-garde ideas, her sounds are bold and seamless. She effortlessly crosses the boundaries of classical, ambient, folk, jazz and contemporary genres with her own performance using a variety of instruments including marimba, percussion, piano, and flute. Her extraordinary talent is on full display with this 40-track album. “Hororo Shoyo”, the ending theme for the series, was released earlier and will be included in the soundtrack. This album is more than an original soundtrack, but a collection that showcases the rich and diverse musicality of Manami Kakudo.

    About Manami Kakudo

    Born in Nagasaki, Japan. Musician and percussionist. She explores free expression of her music domestically and internationally through use of diverse percussion instruments such as marimba, her own voice, spoken word, music boxes and tape players. In 2020, she made her major debut as a solo artist with her first album oar. In 2024, she released her second album Contact. She’s earned the trust of many unique artists through supporting their activities outside of her solo career, such as cero, Haruomi Hosono, Tomoyo Harada, and Shun Ishiwaka Songbook Project. While she has been involved in various forms of music production for commercials, films, stage plays, dance and art, she made her debut as a composer for the anime series Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo. Who Are Mrs. GREEN APPLE and Why is Their Album 10 Making Waves Worldwide?
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Mrs. GREEN APPLE (MGA) ranked No. 13 on the IFPI Global Artist Chart 2025, becoming the only Japanese band to make this year’s list. This follows the recent announcement that their greatest hits album 10 placed No. 10 on the IFPI Global Album Chart 2025.
  • The IFPI Global Charts compile streaming, download, and physical sales data from more than 8,000 participating record companies worldwide to create global rankings of the world’s best-selling artists and albums. MGA’s placement on both charts, alongside many of the world’s most renowned artists, has drawn significant international attention.

    • What Makes MGA So Compelling?

    Lyrics That Resonate With Everyday Life MGA’s songs reach the hearts of people facing hardship, gently encouraging them to keep moving forward. Rather than giving one-sided advice, the lyrics speak from the same perspective as the listener. Their careful choice of words and warmth feel perfectly attuned to today’s times. https://youtu.be/CO0Eoj9aPcs Darling Winner of 67th Japan Record Awards Theme song of Mrs. GREEN APPLE 18Fes The Unique Expressive Power of Vocalist Motoki Ohmori Motoki Ohmori writes, composes, and arranges all of MGA’s songs, while also overseeing every creative aspect of their work, from artwork to music video concepts. His singing, widely praised by industry professionals, effortlessly navigates complex key changes while seamlessly shifting between chest voice, head voice, mixed voice, and falsetto. Combined with the lyrics he crafts, his voice delivers a powerful emotional impact. https://youtu.be/v44zuSMBVNI Heaven Theme song of #IWillTellYoutheTruth A Diverse Musical Style Unbound by Rock Band Conventions Although they perform as a band, their artistry transcends traditional boundaries. Their free-ranging musical style is matched by a striking visual identity, including bold makeup and costumes. From dynamic dance performances in music videos to concerts featuring theatrical elements and elaborate stage production, their work elevates live entertainment to a spectacular level. https://youtu.be/v44zuSMBVNI GOOD DAY - LIVE “BABEL no TOH” 2025 December Edit Concert video https://youtu.be/-zsYJTSw_V0 breakfast Theme song of Fuji TV’s news information program Sun! Shine A Strong Affinity With Anime Collaborations Many of their songs are created as tie-ins, particularly with anime, where their music demonstrates exceptional compatibility. These collaborations often generate a powerful synergy, enhancing both the songs and the anime they accompany. https://youtu.be/MjeiIal1ZR0 lulu. Opening theme of Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End season 2

    About the Greatest Hits Album 10

    The greatest hits album 10 is the band’s second greatest hits album, released on July 8, 2025. Featuring songs from their Phase 2 era onward, the 19-track collection includes signature hits such as “Que Sera Sera,” “Lilac,” and “Darling.” It is a comprehensive showcase of the band’s musical range and diversity Find it on Spotify and Apple Music. Over the ten years since their debut, MGA have released an extraordinary range of music, growing into a band that transcends the conventional boundaries of rock and J-pop. Public Playlists on Streaming Services: This is Mrs. GREEN APPLE and Hajimete no Mrs. GREEN APPLE.

    About Mrs. GREEN APPLE

    Motoki Ohmori (Vo/Gt) instagram.com/motoki_ohmori_mga Hiroto Wakai (Gt) instagram.com/hiloto_wakai_mga Ryoka Fujisawa (Key) instagram.com/ryoka_fujisawa_mga Mrs. GREEN APPLE (MGA) is a three-member band consisting of Motoki Ohmori (vocals/guitar), Hiroto Wakai (guitar), and Ryoka Fujisawa (keyboard). Formed in 2013, Mrs. GREEN APPLE made their major debut in 2015 with the mini-album Variety via EMI Records. In July 2020, they released their first greatest hits album, 5, to mark their 5th anniversary, then temporarily suspended activities. Following a hiatus of about 20 months, they resumed activities in March 2022. The period from March 2022 to December 2025, known as “Phase 2,” saw the band release 37 songs, an unusually high number for just three years and ten months. They made history by being the first artist in J-pop history to surpass 16 billion total streams across their catalog (according to Billboard Japan). To mark their 10th anniversary in 2025, they released their second greatest hits album, 10, which ranked No. 10 on the IFPI Global Album Chart 2025 and has sold over 1 million copies. In the Oricon Annual Ranking 2025, they placed 10 songs in the Top 20 of the Streaming Ranking, setting a record for the most entries in the chart’s history. They also achieved an unprecedented three consecutive wins at the Japan Record Awards and closed NHK’s national year-end program, Kohaku Uta Gassen, establishing themselves as one of Japan’s leading acts. A new song, “Kaze to Machi,” is scheduled for digital release in April 2026, with a new original full-length album, their first in about three years, planned for fall 2026. MyAnimeList Unveils 78 Fan-Selected Titles in “You Should Read This Manga 2026”
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • MyAnimeList has unveiled the final lineup for the fourth annual “You Should Read This Manga 2026,” a fan-driven manga recommendation project designed to spotlight standout titles and help readers discover what to read next.
  • This year’s selection was curated from 12,333 nominations submitted by 2,927 users, spanning 1,077 distinct manga titles. The final lineup features 78 unique manga titles selected across four discovery categories.
  • The project aims to connect readers with manga that deserve broader recognition, while creating new opportunities for discovery across a wide range of genres, styles, and reading experiences.
  • As part of the campaign, MyAnimeList users who read two volumes of any title from the 2026 list during the campaign period will earn a time-limited profile badge. The campaign will run through May 31, 2026.

    • About “You Should Read This Manga 2025”?

    “You Should Read This Manga” is a global manga promotion initiative by MyAnimeList that highlights notable titles through a combination of international user nominations and editorial curation. The project enables fans worldwide to recommend up to 10 titles and share why each work deserves recognition, resulting in a list shaped by both reader enthusiasm and qualitative input.

    “You Should Read This Manga 2026” Categories

    You Should Read This Manga 2026 For manga that readers most strongly want to recommend to others. (e.g. Magical Girl Dandelion, Tsumiki Ogami's Not-So-Ordinary Life) Should Be Anime For manga that fans especially want to see adapted into anime. (e.g. Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate, Rai Rai Rai) Best for Beginners For readers newer to manga, including accessible and highly approachable titles. (e.g. On and Off: Work-Life Imbalance, Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun, Hirayasumi) Unique Art/Story For manga with especially distinctive artwork, storytelling, or creative identity. (e.g. Parashoppers, Gene Bride) Explore the full list: myanimelist.net/readthismanga/2026

    Trends from This Year’s List

    Demographic Balance Fan-voters have the option to select their gender when nominating, and this information is used to curate each category with a balanced list of titles that will appeal to all voters. While half of the selected titles were originally published in shounen or seinen magazines, notably one in four of these titles received more votes from female and non-binary readers. Breakout Titles From the top-voted titles, fan nominations for Gachiakuta, Ichi the Witch, and Tower Dungeon showed remarkable growth, with total nominations increasing by more than three-fold. Newly eligible titles Love Bullet and Phantom Busters also had a significant number of nominations, despite only one and two volumes being available in English, respectively. Titles Not Released in English Of 78 unique titles, eight titles have yet to be released in English. Two of these titles (Studio Cabana and Kemutai Hanashi) have been published in at least four languages (French, German, Italian, Spanish). Four of these titles have only been published in French. English Simulpub Nearly half of the titles released in English have new chapters that are published simultaneously with Japan (30/70 titles), and half of these are simulpubbed by Manga PLUS (16/70 titles). Anime Demand Two-fifths (40%) of the "Should Be Anime" list is available on Manga PLUS, half of which (20%) run in Weekly Shounen Jump magazine. Digital Origins Approximately 25% of the titles come from web-based manga platforms such as Shonen Jump+ instead of physical manga magazines. Third Year Finalists Due to high fan engagement, five titles were featured on the list for their third and final year: Gachiakuta, Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You, Gokurakugai, Hirayasumi, and Magus of the Library. For 2027's edition, these manga will be retired from the eligible titles. Previously retired titles include: Dandadan, The Summer Hikaru Died, and Witch Hat Atelier. Additional Content The project also features bonus recommendation sections created in collaboration with manga publishers and booksellers: Publisher & Bookseller Picks myanimelist.net/readthismanga/2026/publisher-bookseller-picks

    About MyAnimeList

    MyAnimeList is an anime and manga community featuring comprehensive databases maintained by its global user base. item.content:encoded:

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • UNIVERSAL MUSIC LLC and its Japanese-music-focused label Virgin Music, announces a partnership with ANYCOLOR Inc. Together, the two companies will train and produce music for “BY THE BEAT”,a four-member VTuber unit from NIJISANJI EN, the English-speaking branch of ANYCOLOR Inc.
  • As of today, BY THE BEAT embarks upon the road to their major label debut scheduled for 2027. With the release of “Double Vision”, BY THE BEAT takes their first step toward realizing this dream. This track, composed with the idea of comparing their fans, who are indispensable to the members' activities, to “chromatic aberration” (color distortion) is an ambitious piece that blends bouncy electro-house rhythms with rap and vocal chops. The result is a cool, elegant dance track where you can almost feel the very breath of the four members.
  • The production team features Lauren Kaori, who writes songs primarily for J-POP and K-POP acts such as INI and &TEAM; MONJOE, the vocalist and synthesizer player for DATS who has recently been producing and writing songs for artists like BE:FIRST and Number_i, as well as composing music for commercials; and R&B artist, singer-songwriter LOAR, who has provided songs for artists such as Kento Nakajima and BE:FIRST.
  • BY THE BEAT just had a special collab program on their official YouTube channel to commemorate the occasion, and the “Double Vision” music video is now available for streaming!

We're committed to doing our best to release a lot of fashionable music, so I hope we can be under your care! Seible Nyao! My name's Seible, promoter of BY THE BEAT! Let's paint the skies with song and dance, joy and laughter! Join us as we dive into late-night recordings, heartfelt sessions, and exciting rehearsals to bring song and smile to your lips. Will you be the melody to my music? Kaelix Debonair Ya—ho! Kaelix Debonair; charmed, I'm sure! I'm the bouncer of BY THE BEAT. I've always enjoyed singing live, but I'm excited (and nervous) to venture into recording for original music! I'm really thankful to share in this opportunity with my dear friends, so I'll do my best from here on out. Won't you sing along? With the release of their first single “Double Vision”, BY THE BEAT embarks on their major global debut with Universal Music. Please look forward to their future activities.

item.title: Shiro Sagisu Announces Two New Albums and Launches Official YouTube Channel
item.content:encoded:

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Shiro Sagisu, a composer, arranger, music producer, and conductor known for his work on titles such as Evangelion, Bleach, Shin Godzilla, and Shin Ultraman, released two albums simultaneously on March 25, 2026, as part of his new THE WHITE ALBUM series: THE WHITE ALBUM 1 EVANGELION 30TH ANNIVERSARY and THE WHITE ALBUM 2 EVANGELION 30TH ANNIVERSARY.
  • Led by Sagisu himself, the THE WHITE ALBUM series reimagines beloved tracks with orchestral arrangements and other new elements, vividly rekindling the memories of the stories they accompany while breathing new life into the music. The series also includes rare, previously unreleased recordings, letting listeners fully experience the expansive worlds of these works.

item.title: [리뷰] ‘제로 ~붉은 나비~ 리메이크’, 귀신도 예뻐~
[Honey's Anime Interview] PassCode is Overcoming Weakness and Rewriting Fate with "Liberator," Their Latest Song
item.content:encoded:
PassCode continues to redefine the boundaries of music, blending high-energy electronic sounds with heavy metal intensity and explosive vocals. Originally rooted in a more traditional idol style, the group has evolved into a genre-defying act, incorporating a wide range of influences while maintaining their signature edge. With their latest track, “Liberator,” PassCode taps into a darker, more emotional direction inspired by the anime Roll Over and Die. And as they head into their 10th anniversary in 2026, the group shows no signs of slowing down. Dive into our interview with PassCode below!

Nao
Kaede
Hinako
Emily
Interview with PassCode
[gray-hex-decoration]
Thank you for speaking with us once again! But for those who are just discovering PassCode, could you tell us a bit about the group—how it started and what kind of music you create?
At the very beginning, our sound was what you’d typically expect from an idol group. Around that time, more idols were starting to incorporate metal and screams, and our music gradually shifted into the style we have now. While our sound is rooted in metal, we also incorporate a lot of different elements. Emily Arima’s screams are especially distinctive.
For your latest song “Liberator”, during the songwriting process, was there a particular mood, theme, or message you wanted to convey?
I hope the song can convey things like striving to become stronger to protect something important, and being reminded of the true value of the connections between people.
https://youtu.be/TgSG9VxKI-I
What’s the story or meaning behind the title “Liberator”? How did you decide on it?
I felt that SHY’s desire to bring happiness to others, despite all her struggles, is very similar to PassCode. The message we convey isn’t all that different, which is why this song reflects both SHY’s perspective and PassCode’s essence.
This song depicts the life of the anime’s protagonist, Flum, and the lyrics ask the listener, “To protect the people who matter to you, can you overcome your weaknesses, defy fate, and shape the future?” The title Liberator isn’t just about someone who saves others, it also represents someone who frees them from their constraints and even rewrites destiny.
How did the story or themes of the anime “Roll Over and Die” influence the way you approached “Liberator”?
We thought some people might skip the anime’s opening, so we decided to structure the song to start with the vocals right away.
Since there are so many monsters, I think the song ended up with screams that sound like growls, giving it a serious, intense atmosphere.
And if you could spend one day in the world of Roll Over and Die, which character would you want to be, and why?
Cyrill. I’d want to be Cyrill and clear up Flum’s misunderstandings.
I’d want to be Flum so I could watch the cute Milkit up close and have her all to myself.
I’d want to be Sara. Her heart is pure, she’s innocent, and above all, she’s adorable, so I’d like to be her and help a lot of people.
Flum! Strong, cool girls are the best.
What are your goals for 2026, and do you have any messages for your fans?
I want to do lots of things that will get our fans excited. And someday, I’ll go see everyone again.
Thank you always for your support. 2026 is our 10th anniversary year, so I want to make it an even more exciting year!
In 2026, I want to visit places I’ve never been before, both in Japan and abroad, whether for live shows or privately. Thank you for always supporting us, and please look forward to what’s coming next from PassCode!
Releasing lots of cool songs! We’ll continue evolving and come see everyone again.
We've been really enjoying Roll Over and Die, and PassCode’s opening theme is definitely one of the highlights! After this interview, it’s clear just how much the group continues to grow and evolve, and it’s exciting to see where these talented artists are headed after a decade-long journey. Now, if you’ll excuse us, we’ll be going back to blasting “Liberator” at full volume...
Connect with PassCode Official website: passcode-official.com/ X (formerly Twitter): x.com/passcodeo Instagram: instagram.com/passcodeo YouTube: youtube.com/@PASSCODE0000 TikTok: tiktok.com/@passcode_o Facebook: facebook.com/PassCodeOfficial
