[프리뷰] 방치형 야구 게임 신작 해긴, ‘2026 프로야구 GO!’
Daoko’s Upcoming Single “COMIT COMET” Chosen as Opening Theme for Yowayowa Sensei
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Daoko will digitally release her new song “COMIT COMET” on April 12, 2026. The track has been selected as the opening theme for the TV anime Yowayowa Sensei, which begins airing in April 2026.
  • The original manga is currently serialized in Weekly Shonen Magazine. A hugely popular romantic comedy, it follows Hiyori Hiwamura, a timid and somewhat unreliable new English teacher. Though weak and meek in both appearance and personality, she is mistakenly feared by her students as a scary teacher. Supported by her student Abikura, she gradually grows into her role. Despite being at the mercy of her students, she faces them earnestly, gradually building bonds of trust in a story full of humor.
  • The song is composed and arranged by Hideya Kojima, who has worked on numerous Daoko tracks, including “ShibuyaK” and “Moshimo Bokura ga GAME no Shuyaku de.” Blending strong Shibuya-kei influences from the ’90s and 2000s with elements of contemporary overseas funk, the track is described as Daoko’s grooviest and cutest to date. A preview of “COMIT COMET” can be heard in the newly released main promotional video for Yowayowa Sensei.

    • Daoko’s Comment

    While working on the song, I read the original manga and found myself charmed by the cuteness and earnestness of Yowayowa-sensei (Hiyori Hiwamura). I wanted to express that feeling by likening it to the stars, so I teamed up with Hideya Kojima and poured everything into creating a full-on pop track. The result is a “star-core” anisong we’re really proud of. I’m already looking forward to seeing all the different sides of Yowayowa-sensei brought to life in the anime.

    Release Information

    Daoko Digital Single “COMIT COMET” Digital Release Date: April 12, 2026 Lyrics: Daoko Composition: Hideya Kojima, Daoko Arrangement: Hideya Kojima Pre-add/Pre-save it here: lnk.to/COMIT_COMET Jacket Design: Hazuki Tamano (Yoyo Inc.) Key Illustration: Akatsuki Hono Supervision: Yoshiko Takemoto ©Kamio Fukuchi, KODANSHA/“Yowayowa Sensei”Production Committee
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    Daoko's Profile

    Tokyo-born in 1997, Daoko rose to prominence at 15 with a song uploaded to Niconico Douga, making her major debut in 2015. Since then, she’s been active across music, anime, and commercial projects. Her hit collaboration with Kenshi Yonezu, “Uchiage Hanabi,” has surpassed 600 million views on YouTube. A multi-talented creator, Daoko has also written novels, organized live events, held painting exhibitions, and acted, earning high acclaim both in Japan and abroad. She founded her own agency, teftef, in 2019. Alongside her solo activities, she began performing as part of the band QUBIT in 2023. In 2024, she released her first solo album in about four years, Slash-&-Burn, and drew attention with her featured appearance on Shiina Ringo’s seventh album track, “a grand triumphant return.” In 2025, she attracted further notice for her collaboration with Giga & TeddyLoid, “ACT feat. Daoko.” On November 19, her latest EP meta millefeuille was released digitally.   • Pokémon feat. Hatsune Miku VOLTAGE Live! is the first-ever collaborative performance between Pokémon and Hatsune Miku. A special-edition Blu-ray featuring all the songs from the live evening performance of March 22 will be released August 26, 2026.

    “I want to sing all the PokéMiku songs with you!” PokéMiku hits the stage! Starring Hatsune Miku and the other virtual singers, along with a host of Pokémon running about on stage, performing the entire catalogue of PokéMiku songs! Pokémon feat.     Live photo and illustration booklet Stage Visual Acrylic Stand (Hatsune Miku & Meloetta) Set of postcards Special case

    About "PokéMiku"

    In 1996, the video game Pokémon was released. In 2007, the vocal synthesis software featuring Hatsune Miku was released. PokéMiku is a collaborative project between two franchises that have enriched both the real and virtual worlds. Since its launch on August 31, 2023, we’ve been collaborating with a diverse group of creators who continue to explore new forms of expression by sampling music from the Pokémon series to create songs and music videos performed by Hatsune Miku and her friends, as well as creating illustrations such as the “18 Variations of Hatsune Miku & her Pokémon.”

    About Pokémon

    Pokémon, short for Pocket Monsters, are mysterious creatures shrouded in secrets. The franchise began in 1996 with two games for GameBoy, Pokémon Red and Pokémon Green. The games are packed with elements such as the “collectible” aspect of catching and raising pokémon, and the “social” aspect of trading and battling with friends. The franchise has since become a worldwide phenomenon, expanding to include card games, TV anime and movies, apps, and merchandise.

    About Hatsune Miku

    A software that allows anyone to create songs by entering lyrics and melodies, developed by Crypton Future Media, Inc. It quickly became a major movement as numerous creators began making music with “Hatsune Miku” and uploading the songs online. Since gaining attention as a character, “Hatsune Miku” now performs as a virtual singer with live performances and merchandise, with their popularity spreading worldwide. *Kagamine Rin, Kagamine Len, Megurine Luka, MEIKO, and KAITO are also virtual singers developed by Crypton Future Media, Inc.

item.title: Mirror Shibuya, an Illustrated Audio Drama Starring SZNO, the Multidimensional Artist from Bandai Namco Music Live × MusicRay’n, Begins Streaming March 21, 2026
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Bandai Namco Music Live Inc. (Head office: Shibuya-ku, Tokyo; President: Yoshitaka Tao) has announced that Mirror Shibuya, an illustrated audio drama starring SZNO (pronounced “Suzuno”), will begin streaming on SZNO’s YouTube channel on March 21, 2026.
  • SZNO is a multidimensional artist project operating in both the real and virtual realms, jointly developed by Bandai Namco Music Live Inc. and MusicRay’n. Mirror Shibuya will be a six-episode story depicting a series of strange occurrences in Shibuya. Viewers can further immerse themselves in SZNO’s world through the songs and videos released on her YouTube channel.
  • The world and character concepts for SZNO were developed by a stellar lineup of creators, including Jin, the creator of Kagerou Project; Ritao (PHASE STUDIO), who contributed to KAF and Project SEKAI: Colorful Stage! feat. Hatsune Miku; and Seiji Mizushima, known for directing Mobile Suit Gundam 00.
  • In the second teaser video, it was announced that voice actress Eriko Nakamura, known for her role as Haruka Amami in THE IDOLM@STER, will play the mysterious bat in Mirror Shibuya. Seven VTubers from the MEWLIVE production, operated by Bandai Namco Music Live, will also appear: Kotori Koiwai as BearTrice Kumano, Nozomi Suzuhara as Kurone Yousagi, Yuno Mihanada, Ririka Tsukimia, Miu Koneko, Roiro Yamiyori, and Nemumi Nukunuku.
  • The project is planned as a new urban fantasy work combining music, subculture, and urban legends, centered on both real Shibuya and another Shibuya. Further updates will be announced on SZNO’s official social media and website.
    • https://youtu.be/atM-DEpv-g4 “Hoshii” (SZNO’s 5th single), which is played in the 2nd teaser video, is now available on music streaming websites! Links: lnk.to/LZC-3301 Official Audio: youtube.com/watch?v=PFOtoKK3PBQ　 https://youtu.be/PFOtoKK3PBQ Lyrics, Composition: Ren Nakai Arrangement: Yamato

    Staff

    Setting/Character Design Concept Collaboration: Jin Character Design: Ritao (PHASE STUDIO) Scenario: Hisakatsu Kuroki Music Director: Seiji Mizushima Production: Hifumi, Inc. Planning and Production: SZNO Project (Bandai Namco Music Live, MusicRay’n)

    Cast

    SZNO: SZNO Yuno: Yuno Mihanada Ririka: Ririka Tsukimia Miu: Miu Koneko Roiro: Roiro Yamiyori Nemumi: Nemumi Nukunuku Kumano: BearTrice Kumano Kurone: Kurone Yousagi Bat: Eriko Nakamura

    Story

    Two Shibuyas: one of shadow, one of light. In the shadow, a sinister presence stirs, spreading fear and negative emotions among the people. In the midst of all this, Yuno, a member of the idol group Spark★Twinkle, is attacked and falls unconscious. When she awakens, she finds herself in a strange, mirrored world where everything is flipped. At her lowest point, a mysterious girl named SZNO appears. What is the hidden truth of Shadow Shibuya? And what is SZNO’s true identity and purpose? A story of intertwining mysteries is about to unfold in the darkness.

    About SZNO

    SZNO is a multidimensional artist project that operates in both the real and virtual realms. It was born from a collaboration between Bandai Namco Music Live, known for its Lantis label and expertise in producing music content like the Love Live! series, and MusicRay’n, a Sony Music Group company renowned for discovering and nurturing talent such as Sphere, TrySail, and CHiCO. A stellar lineup of creators has come together for this project, including Jin, the creator of the Kagerou Project, and Ritao (PHASE STUDIO), who has been involved in creative work for KAF and Project SEKAI: Colorful Stage! feat. Hatsune Miku. As new songs and story videos are released, the world of SZNO is gradually revealed. Showcasing a range of styles with their debut single “xx,” second single “flag,” and third single “21g,” SZNO has captured attention, with the music videos for “xx” and “flag” each surpassing one million views. Their fourth single, “Mata ne,” is a ballad that wraps listeners in a bittersweet yet warm mood, carried by tender, compassionate, and crystal-clear vocals. The accompanying official music video features SZNO appearing outdoors for the first time, contemporary dance elements, and connections to their first single, “xx,” making it a must-see.

    Social Media and Website

    YouTube: youtube.com/@szno_xx X (formerly Twitter): x.com/szno_xx Official Site: lantis.jp/szno

    About MEWLIVE

    A VTuber production operated by Bandai Namco Music Live, Mewlive brings together a diverse roster of talent, from experienced voice actresses and artists to those who began their careers from scratch through auditions. The group values close engagement with fans through game streams, casual chats, music activities, live performances, and both online and real-world events. item.title: ZAQ to Digitally Release “Liar Veil,” Ending Theme for Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester, on April 2
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • ZAQ’s new song “Liar Veil” has been chosen as the ending theme for the anime Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester, which will begin airing in April 2026. This marks ZAQ’s fourth collaboration with the Classroom of the Elite series, and the first time she has performed an ending theme for the franchise.
  • Built on a hip-hop and jazz foundation, “Liar Veil” combines a simple structure with intricate melodic lines. The lyrics are written from the heroine’s perspective, further enriching the world of the series. The song will be released digitally on April 2, ahead of the CD release on April 22.
  • The tracklist and jacket art have also been revealed. Inspired by the title “Liar Veil,” the front cover evokes an eerie yet alluring atmosphere, hinting at truths hidden behind a veil. The back cover features Tsubasa Nanase and Ichika Amasawa, with protagonist Kiyotaka Ayanokoji appearing in the background. What truths lie hidden beneath these veils? The artwork invites fans to reflect on this question while exploring the song’s lyrics.

    • Product Information

    Title: Liar Veil Release Date: April 22, 2026 Title Track Early Digital Release: April 2, 2026 Product No.: LACM-24820 Price: ¥1,320 (tax included) Tracklist 1. Liar Veil Lyrics/Composition/Arrangement: ZAQ 2. Danmari Lyrics/Composition/Arrangement: ZAQ 3. Liar Veil (Off Vocal) 4. Danmari (Off Vocal)

    ZAQ's Profile

    ZAQ began playing piano at age three and graduated from a university music program with a degree in piano. While studying classical music, she also immersed herself in rock, R&B, hip-hop, and other pop genres, and was struck by the musical sophistication of anime songs. In 2012, she debuted as a creator by writing, composing, and arranging a character song for the TV anime Future Diary. In October of the same year, she made her major debut with “Sparkling Daydream,” the opening theme for Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!. She has since performed opening themes for series including Trinity Seven, Concrete Revolutio, and Classroom of the Elite. She also wrote, composed, and co-arranged the theme song for Animelo Summer Live 2017 -THE CARD-, one of Japan’s largest anime music events, further establishing herself as both an artist and a creator. In recent years, she has provided songs to numerous artists across label lines. As an arranger, sound producer, and singer-songwriter, ZAQ aims to forge a new “classic” style of anime music in a scene that often trends toward uniformity. Official Site: zaqzaqzaq.jp/profile.html Official X: x.com/ZAQinfo ZAQ X: x.com/zaxic_r

PassCode Releases Documentary of Arena Show “PassCode YOKOHAMA BUNTAI 2025 ‘DESTINEX’” to Celebrate New Track “Liberator”
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • On March 4, 2026, the female vocal and dance group PassCode released their new single “Liberator.” The Blu-ray included with the Limited First Edition features the track’s first live performance during PassCode YOKOHAMA BUNTAI 2025 “DESTINEX,” held on November 9, 2025.
  • To mark the release, PassCode has unveiled a 35-minute documentary on YouTube, going behind the scenes of PassCode YOKOHAMA BUNTAI 2025 “DESTINEX.” The film follows the members for several days as they prepare for the arena show, offering rare footage that captures their determination and tension leading up to the big day.
  • “Liberator” is currently being used as the opening theme of the TV anime Roll Over and Die. The song pairs lyrics that reflect the feelings of the protagonist, Flum, with chilling shouted vocals that evoke its dark world, while a grand choir chorus adds further depth.
  • The music video, directed by Takuya Oyama of VANLI, is also now available. It features a dark fantasy aesthetic, with meticulously designed spaces created through a combination of CG and VFX.
  • In conjunction with the single’s release, PassCode will hold a short tour of Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka, titled the “Liberator Release Tour 2026.” They are also set to appear at DEAD POP FESTiVAL 2026 on April 4 at a special outdoor venue in Higashi‑Ogishima East Park in Kawasaki. With the group celebrating the 10th anniversary of their debut this October, fans can look forward to more exciting news.
    • https://youtu.be/giLiHAcLqrE

    Product Information

    New Single “Liberator” Release Date: March 4, 2026 Artist: PassCode Limited First Edition (CD+Blu-ray): ¥8,250 (tax included) / LAMR-34040 Standard Edition (CD only) ¥1,540 (tax included) / LAMR-4040 CD (Limited First Edition & Standard Edition) 1.     About PassCode

    PassCode consists of four members: Nao Minami, Kaede Takashima, Hinako Ogami, and Emily Arima. They have a versatile repertoire based on a band sound, punctuated by their distinctive shouts and screams, and have performed at numerous major festivals such as SUMMER SONIC and ROCK IN JAPAN FESTIVAL, earning broad support from both rock enthusiasts and idol fans. After making their major debut in 2016, they released their first international album Ex Libris PassCode in America, Europe, and Canada under the UK’s JPU Records in October 2018. The track “Ichikabachika” from their 2019 album CLARITY was selected as the opening theme for the TV drama Kakegurui season 2 and the movie Kakegurui. In 2020, their single “STARRY SKY,” which was chosen as the theme song for the drama 182 Days Left, earned them their first-ever No. 1 on the Oricon Weekly Single Chart and Billboard JAPAN Weekly Single Chart. They also made their debut appearance on Nippon Broadcasting System’s All Night Nippon 0. In February 2022, they held their first concert at Nippon Budokan. In 2023, they embarked on their first US tour, “PassCode US / JAPAN TOUR 2023 -GROUNDSWELL-,” which included stops in Dallas, Los Angeles, and New York, as well as 11 cities and 12 venues in Japan. In June 2024, they moved to Bandai Namco Music Live. Their September release “WILLSHINE” was chosen as the OP theme for season 2 of the anime SHY, and their new song “SKILLAWAKE” was selected as the OP theme for season 2 of As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World. item.title: TV anime Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo theme songs announced!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo was first serialized in Shogakukan’s monthly shonen manga magazine, Gessan. The highly-rated series that has won the U-NEXT award for the 2022 Next Manga Awards, ranked first by multiple bookstores for manga recommended by staff in 2023, and been received enthusiastically by professional buyers has been adapted into an anime that will begin airing in April 2026. The story is a homely comedy that centers around an encounter between first-year middle school student Arata Kouda and Kujima, a strange creature that crossed over to Japan from Russia, that triggers a gradual change in his household.
  • The opening theme song to this highly anticipated anime will be done by none other than Galileo Galilei! The rock band is well known by anime fans thanks to its ties to various anime and their hit theme songs for series’ such as Ano Hana: The Flower We Saw and season two of Ao no Orchestra. Their newest single “Komorebizaka” was born from a heartfelt request by Akira Konna, the author of Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo, and was written specifically to serve as the opening theme song for the new anime.
  • The band’s signature transparent melodies and lyrics by their frontman Yuuki Ozaki craft a beautiful and emotional song born from mutual respect between artists, acting like a mirror into the heartwarming world of Kujima. This marks their second consecutive collaboration with an anime, following their single “Amadeus” which was released last October.
  • In addition, the ending theme song will be performed by percussionist and composer Manami Kakudo, who will be handling the composition of the anime soundtrack and theme song for the first time. Previously, she’s performed as a percussionist for various artists such as cero, Haruomi Hosono, Tomoyo Harada, and Shun Ishiwaka Songbook Project. She’s been actively releasing music, including her major debut album oar in 2020 and her second album Contact in 2024. Her cover of Maki Asakawa’s “Watashi no Kinyoubi”, featured on oar, gained significant attention on Spotify. In 2026, she began expanding her activities into live performances and music video production. She’s referred to as a “genius” among her peers for her rare sensibilities and one-of-a-kind methods.
  • The lyrics, composition, arrangement and vocals for the ending theme song “Hororo Shoyo” (“shoyo” means to stroll or take a walk) was created entirely by Manami Kakudo herself. The edgy song was created with the friendship between Kujima and Arata in mind. It’s a heartwarming track with a simple, child-like melody that gradually infuses modern and Latin American musical elements. Repeated listens offer a strange experience that allows the track to seep into your ears and savor her extraordinary talent.
  • The opening theme song and ending theme song will begin pre-streaming Friday, April 10 at midnight (JST).
  • The artists have shared their comments! Along with this press release, the author Akira Konno also gave a special comment regarding the new theme songs.

    • Comment from Yuuki Ozaki from Galileo Galilei (“Komorebizaka” OP theme)

    When I read the original work ahead of producing the track, it brought back feelings from when I was in my teens. Like when I would watch the birds flying in the sky while thinking about things at that age. This work captured the feeling of being small and having a separate inner world that overlaps with the landscape in a way that feels like “art.” Rather than put it into words, I created a track by embracing Kujima and the story’s atmosphere as my own melancholy, while always keeping characters in mind. I think that’s why the track goes so well with the story. I was incredibly happy to hear that the author Konno-sensei listened to my music before. This is a special collaboration in which you can feel the connection between our music and the author’s work. Find “Komorebizaka” (OP theme song): lnk.to/GG_Komorebizaka

    Comment from Yuuki Ozaki from Galileo Galilei (“Komorebizaka” OP theme)

    Hello, I’m Manami Kakudo and I’m performing the ending theme song for TV anime Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo. My hope is that different landscapes unfold at the entrance and exit through the story and the music. I made this song hoping that it will become that device. Find “Hororo Shoyo” (ED theme song): lnk.to/KakudoManami_Hororo_Shoyo

    Comment from Akira Konno (author of Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo)

    About “Komorebizaka”: Before discussions about an anime adaptation began, I often thought about how Galileo Galilei would make a great fit for this series while I was drawing Kujima. “Komorebizaka” is a song that’s chill but warm, and allows you to feel the vastness of the sky while sitting on the ground. I’m grateful that this song expands the world of Kujima even more! About “Hororo Shoyou”: It feels like watching Arata and Hororo from a distance as they walk. Kakudo-san’s voice is wonderful, soothing, and the instrumentals sound like birds chirping or trees rustling. It’s a song that leaves a gentle afterglow. I want to listen to it while taking a walk.

    Galileo Galilei's Profile

    Yuuki Ozaki (vocals, guitar) and Kazuki Ozaki (drums) formed the rock band in 2007 in Wakkanai, Hokkaido. In 2008, they won the Senko Riot grand prix and made their major debut in 2010 with their first mini album Hamanasu no Hana. Their transparent melodies and delicate lyrics have gathered support from fans around the world. After their debut, they released numerous hits such as “Natsuzora” (OP theme song for Big Windup! 2) and “Aoi Shiori” (OP theme song for Ano Hana: The Flower We Saw). In 2016, after their concert at the Nippon Budokan, they went on hiatus but have since resumed activities since October 2022 with a new lineup featuring Yuuki Ozaki, Kazuki Ozaki, Masaki Okazaki (bass) and original founding member Fumito Iwai (guitar). On October 11, 2025, the guitarist DAIKI, who had been an active member in Bird Bear Hare and Fish (BBHF) alongside Yuuki and Kazuki and had served as a support guitarist for Galileo Galilei, officially joined the band. They released “Amadeus”, the OP theme song for TV anime Ao no Orchestra Season 2, that same month. Official Website: galileogalilei.jp Official YouTube: youtube.com/@GalileoGalileiOfficial X Account: x.com/galileo_news Instagram: instagram.com/galileogalileiphoto TikTok: tiktok.com/@gg_galileo

    Manami Kakudo's Profile

    Born in Nagasaki, Japan. Musician and percussionist. She explores free expression of her music domestically and internationally through use of diverse percussion instruments such as marimba, her own voice, spoken word, music boxes and tape players. In 2020, she made her major debut as a solo artist with her first album oar. In 2024, she released her second album Contact. She’s earned the trust of many unique artists through supporting their activities outside of her solo career, such as cero, Haruomi Hosono, Tomoyo Harada, and Shun Ishiwaka Songbook Project. While she has been involved in various forms of music production for commercials, films, stage plays, dance and art, she made her debut as a composer for the anime series Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo. Official Website: manamikakudo.com Official YouTube: youtube.com/@manami_kakudo X Account: x.com/cat_typingg Instagram: instagram.com/manamikakudo_

item.title: ASH DA HERO to Release New Single on May 27! “BELIEVERS” Chosen as Opening Theme for Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2
item.content:encoded:

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • ASH DA HERO has announced the release of their new single “BELIEVERS” on May 27, 2026. The title track will serve as the opening theme for Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2, marking the band’s first anime tie-in since 2024.
  • The new song “BELIEVERS” was once again produced by sound producer Ryo “Lefty” Miyata. Built on a fast-paced band sound, the track is a high-energy rock number about pushing forward despite feelings of inferiority and inner conflict, delivered in the direct, passionate style that defines the band.
  • Ahead of the broadcast, the latest PV for Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 was released, offering the first preview of “BELIEVERS.” The song will be released digitally in advance on April 13 to coincide with the start of the TV broadcast. The cover artwork features a newly drawn illustration of Will created specifically for this release.
  • The CD will also include several coupling tracks: a newly reworked version of “Prologue,” the song that marked the beginning of ASH DA HERO, reflecting the band’s journey over the past ten years; and a self-cover of “MANIFESTO,” originally a song by GYROAXIA for which ASH wrote both the lyrics and music.
  • The first press limited edition will include a Blu-ray Disc featuring footage from the world tour final held on November 8, 2025, at KT Zepp Yokohama, which also served as the band’s 10th anniversary concert.

    • Comment from ASH DA HERO's Vocalist, ASH

    I’m ASH from ASH DA HERO, and we’ll be performing the opening theme for Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2. I’m a big fan of the original manga, so I’m truly happy and honored to have been entrusted with the theme song. Season 2 has some shocking developments in store. “BELIEVERS” is a song I wrote with my love for Wistoria and my support for Will and the others. I hope this song gives you the courage to take that first swing. Thanks for your support!

Eir Aoi Kicks Off New Chapter with Lantis: New Song Selected as OP for Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Eir Aoi will release a new song through Lantis, the music label operated by Bandai Namco Music Live. The track, titled “MONSTER,” has been selected as the opening theme for the TV anime Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester.
  • “MONSTER” combines Eir Aoi’s signature intense sound with elements of digital rock to create a bold, hard-hitting track worthy of marking this new chapter in her career. The lyrics were written by Eir Aoi herself as a tribute to the series.
  • A CD featuring “MONSTER” is set for release on April 22, 2026. It will be available in three editions—Type A, Type B, and Type C—and will include the title track along with three additional new songs. Further details will be announced at a later date.

    • Comment from Eir Aoi

    I’m delighted to be singing the opening theme for Classroom of the Elite, a series loved by many people. I’m filled with gratitude for the opportunity to be involved in its production. This song is quite intense, with the theme of how Ayanokoji-kun is seen as a “monster” by those around him. I hope you’ll enjoy this track, where I explore a new side of my music through a digital rock sound, along with the anime.

    Product Information

item.title: 압도적 규모의 펫수집 RPG '스톤에이지 키우기' 미리보기
[리뷰] 실력만큼 중요한 장비발? '마리오 테니스 피버'
New Ghost in the Shell Scheduled for July 2026! With Music by Taisei Iwasaki, Ryo Konishi and Yuki Kanesaka!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Ghost in the Shell is a series revered by fans worldwide, and continues to leave an impact on creators across borders and generations. In conjunction with the opening of the first-ever Ghost in the Shell exhibition “Ghost and the Shell”, currently being held at NODE Tokyo, it was announced that the latest TV anime production of Ghost in the Shell will be airing in Japan starting July 2026. The very first key visual and promotional video was released as well.
  • The first key visual and original artwork from the series is currently on display at the “Ghost and the Shell” exhibition.
  • The musical producers for the new series have also been announced! The musical director is Taisei Iwasaki, known for composing the score for Ryuu to Sobakasu Hime (Belle), which won a Japan Academy Award for “Best Music”. In addition, Ryo Konishi, who served as the music director the Osaka World Expo and produces for artists such as Chara+YUKI, Mrs. Green Apple, TOMOO and more, will be collaborating with U.S.-based composer Yuki Kanesaka, who produced the music for TV anime Dr. Stone.
  • Updates will be posted to the new Ghost in the Shell website and official social media accounts.
    • https://youtu.be/xl8bNn3BRRM Ghost in the Shell Exhibition “Ghost and the Shell” tokyonode.jp/sp/exhibition-ghostintheshell

    About Taisei Iwasaki

    Award-winning musician who’s known for his work on Ryuu to Sobakasu Hime, Hateshinaki Scarlet, Giant God Warrior Appears in Tokyo, TV anime Kekkai Sensen, Spriggan, Marriage Toxin, and more. Moteki and Ryuu to Sobakasu Hime won the 35th and 45th Japan Academy Awards for “Best Music” respectively, while Ryuu to Sobakasu Hime went on to win the 36th Japan Golden Disc Award for “Best Soundtrack of the Year”.

    Comment from Taisei Iwasaki

    “In middle school, I came across a magazine with an illustration of Motoko Kusanagi inside. That was the moment when I discovered Ghost in the Shell. Its unique touch and color set it apart from other works. Even the author’s name, Masamune Shirow, captivated me. I was stunned. I’ve since encountered the series in various forms. Now, I am truly honored to be a part of this project and its long history. The concept I envisioned for this project is “Sound Public Security Sector 9”. With the help of my talented friends, I will strive to make this long-awaited work even better. May we all come together soon.

    About Ryo Konishi

    Born July 25, 1988 in Tokyo. Musical composer, arranger, and performer on saxophone, flute, clarinet, synthesizer, and vocoder. He served as the musical director for the opening ceremony of the Osaka World Expo, and has produced for numerous theatre productions, drama productions, and artists including Chara+YUKI, Mrs. Green Apple, TOMOO and more. His style as a performer involves mastering and playing multiple instruments, making him a valuable multi-instrumentalist in multiple settings including Chara and Millenium Parade led by Daiki Tsuneta. He’s participated in numerous festivals both domestically and internationally, including NHK’s “Kohaku Uta Gassen”, Fuji Rock Festival, and Summer Sonic.

    Comment from Ryo Konishi

    “I first watched Innocence when I was in junior high school. Ever since my heart was stolen by its intense charm, I’ve pursued everything related to Ghost in the Shell. Its influence is deeply ingrained into my own work and philosophy. At first, I couldn’t believe that I was entrusted with creating music for this work, but I wanted to embrace this precious world. With that feeling in my heart, I took on this project with my entire body and soul. Follow the whispers of my ghost!”

    About Yuki Kanesaka

    A music creator and composer based in Boston, creating music daily across the U.S. and Europe. In recent years, he’s been working as an assistant professor at Berklee College of Music, discovering music and developing technology, while also developing products for companies like Sony and AlphaThetha/Pioneer. He enjoys working and can play around 74 instruments. Recent works: - Shiryu Sejima (artist) - Dr. Stone/Jujutsu Kaisen/Snowball Earth (anime music) - olkswagen/Kyupi/Meiji/Yonex (commercial music) - Jojo’s Bizarre Adventure/Sonic Racing (game music)

    Comment from Yuki Kanesaka

    “I began with a single utterance: “Ghost in the Shell? Never heard of it!”, before immediately ordering every English and Japanese version I could get on Amazon. As I dove into composing at my private studio in Boston, a vast number of motifs began preparing for their musical journey. To Nashville, where my allies wait, for additional recordings. To a Shanghai hotel, for tailoring. Finally, the motifs’ journey comes to an end in Tokyo, transforming from a phenomenon called “a passage” into a message called “a suite”. A journey without hesitation, without blurring, without rewriting. These songs are like maps, etched with a trail of my thoughts and impulses. Ghost in the Shell Official Accounts Official Website: theghostintheshell-anime.jp Official X: @thegits_animeEN Official Instagram: @thegits_anime

AVIOT Opens Pre-Orders for Second Wave of The Prince of Tennis II Collaboration True Wireless Earbuds!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • AVIOT, operated by Preseed Japan Corporation, which manufactures and sells consumer electronics, has opened orders for its second wave of The Prince of Tennis II collaboration true wireless earbuds. The latest additions to the line-up are the TE-V1R-TP3, inspired by Hyōtei Gakuen Junior High School (Hyōtei), and the TE-V1R-TP4, inspired by Shitenhoji Junior High School (Shitenhoji).
  • Based on the TE-V1R, the TE-V1R-TP3 and TE-V1R-TP4 are special edition wireless earbuds designed to fully capture the charm of The Prince of Tennis II.
  • Both models feature eight characters’ voices. The Hyōtei model includes Keigo Atobe, Yushi Oshitari, Ryoh Shishido, Gakuto Mukahi, Jiroh Akutagawa, Munehiro Kabaji, Chotaroh Otori, and Wakashi Hiyoshi, while the Shitenhoji model features Kuranosuke Shiraishi, Senri Chitose, Koharu Konjiki, Yuji Hitouji, Kenya Oshitari, Gin Ishida, Hikaru Zaizen, and Kintaroh Toyama.
  • Together, the two models contain 330 newly recorded voice lines, from operational voice guidance for notifications like power and connection status to a “random voice” function that plays memorable quotes from the series. Users can switch between 16 modes through the dedicated app.
  • From the earbuds and charging case to the packaging, every detail has been carefully crafted for a premium, fan-focused experience, with audio tuned by series composer UZA for optimal music playback. In the promotional video, Kenya Oshitari and Yushi Oshitari themselves introduce the products. Please check it out!
    • https://youtu.be/LKSdf6aG2o8

    Product Characteristics

    Base Model The TE-V1R is the latest model in AVIOT’s popular V series, which has sold approximately 190,000 units*. The earbuds offer an ultra-long battery life of 19 hours (62 hours with the charging case) and Adaptive Hybrid Noise Canceling, which automatically adjusts the noise reduction strength based on the surrounding environment. They also feature the new Hybrid Dual Driver 2.0 for enhanced sound quality, LDAC™ support for high-resolution playback, and wireless charging functionality, making them a high-grade model that perfectly balances sound quality and functionality. *As of the end of April 2025 Special Voice Lines The earbuds feature over 330 newly recorded lines across two models, including voice guidance for notifications such as power and connection status, as well as a “random voice” function with memorable quotes from the series. The Hyōtei and Shitenhoji models each offer eight modes featuring the schools’ regular players, switchable through the app. To see the other voice lines, please check the product page: aviot.jp/product/te-v1r-tp-s2. Special Design The charging cases sport glossy Hyōtei and Shitenhoji-themed color schemes, with original series logos on the sides and metal earbud parts. Complementing the first wave’s Seigaku and Rikkai models, this series offers a cohesive, collector-friendly set.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    Special Packaging The packaging showcases brand-new illustrations of the players enjoying the earbuds, highlighting their expressions and charm.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    Special Tuning Following the first wave of collaboration models, these earbuds also feature sound tuning by UZA, the composer behind The Prince of Tennis II soundtrack. Enjoy a unique audio experience that lets you feel the excitement of The Prince of Tennis Festival wherever you are.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    Product Information

    TE-V1R-TP3, TP4 Price: ¥22,880 (incl. tax) Pre-orders currently open Expected Delivery Date: December 17, 2025 or later Available at: AVIOT ONLINE MALL shop.aviot.jp/products/te-v1r-tp-s2 → Basic Specifications ・Driver: Hybrid type with φ10mm dynamic and balanced armature drivers ・Microphone for calls: MEMS microphone ・Battery capacity: Earbud single ear 85mAh / Case 600mAh ・Talk time*: Up to 9 hours ・Playback time*: Up to 19 hours (with charging case: up to 62 hours) ・Earbud charging time: Approximately 1.5 hours ・Charging port: USB Type-C ・Water resistance level**: Equivalent to IPX4 ・Weight: Earbud single ear approximately 6.5g ・Other features: Multipoint support (up to 2 devices), single ear usage, earbuds can be individually turned on or off, fast charging (up to 120 minutes of playback with a 10-minute charge), wireless charging → Accessories ・Silicone earpieces (1 pair each in sizes S/M/L) ・USB Type-C cable ・User manual → Bluetooth Specifications ・Supported codecs: SBC, AAC, LDAC ・Supported profiles: A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, HSP ・Bluetooth version: 5.3 ・Number of Bluetooth multi-pairing registrable devices: 8 *Exact time may vary depending on your usage environment **Earbuds only

    About AVIOT

    AVIOT, born in 2018 as the original brand of Preseed Japan Corporation, aims to deliver products that convey high-quality Japanese craftsmanship in sound, delicate and beautiful design, and easy-to-use electronic products. In 2023, the brand restarted with the addition of “A Visionary Innovation On Technology” to its name, aiming to be an electronic devices brand that goes beyond the framework of audio-visual products. The vision is to bring innovation through the power of technology and deliver “something that changes your lives” to customers. Company Name: Preseed Japan Corporation Representative: CEO Founder Hirokazu Tsuchiyama Address: 4-16-7 Sendagaya, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo 151-0051, DT Building 3F Business Activities: 1) Manufacturing, importing, and selling wireless audio equipment and IoT-related products 2) Importing and selling mobile accessories 3) Managing an e-commerce website AVIOT Official Website: aviot.jp AVIOT Official X (formerly Twitter): twitter.com/AVIOT_JP AVIOT Official Instagram: instagram.com/aviotjapan AVIOT Official TikTok: tiktok.com/discover/AVIOT

item.title: Nao Toyama Announces Upcoming Hiatus. Final Live Performance at the Nippon Budokan to Be Held Next Year!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Voice actress and singer Nao Toyama’s long-held dream “to reunite with everyone at the Nippon Budokan” will be coming true next year. The 10th Anniversary Final Live “Over The Rainbow at Nippon Budokan” will be held on March 11, 2027 and her upcoming hiatus from musical activities was also announced.
  • The announcement was made during a solo concert on February 8 in front of an in-person and livestream audience. She conveyed her message with a letter and requested her fans’ help in making her dream come true. She described her reason for the upcoming hiatus as “a positive decision to deliver a culmination of her decade-long journey and to think about the next phase of her career.” She did not announce when her upcoming hiatus will end. Her final concert will be held next year on her birthday, March 11, and promises to be a special event filled with emotions and shared alongside all those who’ve walked this path together with her, as they step forward into the future. Tickets to the concert will go on sale Wednesday, March 11, 2026 at 10 AM, Japan Standard Time.
  • Furthermore, a new album will be coming out as a culmination of her ten year-long musical career leading up to the Budokan concert. More details will be announced at a later date.
  • In addition, a live birthday countdown stream will be hosted on YouTube on Tuesday, March 10 at 11 PM (JST) where she’ll share more information about tickets and exclusive details regarding her final concert.
    • Nao Toyama’s Special 10th Anniversary Website: jvcmusic.co.jp/flyingdog/toyamanao/10th

    Concert Information

    Title: 10th Anniversary Final Live “Over the Rainbow at Nippon Budokan” Performer: Nao Toyama Date/Time: Thursday, March 11, 2027 at 6 PM (Doors open at 5 PM) Place: Nippon Budokan, Tokyo

    Nao Toyama's Profile

    Birthday: March 11 Blood Type: A Hometown: Tokyo Hobbies: Singing, dancing, playing the electric organ Nao Toyama made her voice acting debut in 2010. She attracted a lot of attention for her role as Kanon Nakagawa in the TV anime The World God Only Knows. After that, she went on to play characters in numerous popular works, such as Karen Kujo in Kin-iro Mosaic, Chitoge Kirisaki in Nisekoi, Reina Prowler in MacrossΔ, and Rin Shima in Yuru CampΔ. She also belongs to popular groups Rhodanthe* and Walküre, both of which were born in anime, and has enthralled fans with her clear voice and flawless performances. On February 1, 2017, she made her debut as a singer with “True Destiny/Chain the world,” tie-up songs for the anime Chain Chronicle: Haecceitas no Hikari, and on February 3, 2018, she held her first solo live at the Nippon Budokan. In 2019, she held her first solo tour and performed overseas in Taipei and Shanghai. In 2020, she celebrated her 10th anniversary as a voice actress by releasing her character song best album “Special Thanks” and holding a 10th anniversary concert titled “Special Thanks! Festival” at Tokyo Garden Theater. In 2022, she celebrated the 5th anniversary of her singing debut with five projects. On February 22, 2025, she held her solo live concert “Watashi no Kangaeta Muteki na Setlist!” Social Media Official X (formerly Twitter): @naobou_official Line account search ID: toyamanao Artist homepage: toyamanao.com Official blog: ameblo.jp/naobouofficial Official YouTube channel: youtube.com/c/naobou_channel Instagram: @naobou_official TikTok account: tiktok.com/@official_naotoyama

item.title: Winners Announced for MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2025, with Publication in Japan Confirmed!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="Illustration by Seira Minami" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • KADOKAWA CORPORATION, in partnership with qdopp Inc. and MyAnimeList Co., Ltd., co-hosted the MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2025 – THE ISEKAI presented by KADOKAWA. The English-language isekai fantasy novel contest was held on Honeyfeed, a novel submission platform operated by qdopp, with the goal of discovering exceptional storytelling talent from around the world. The winning works were announced today on the contest’s official webpage.
  • Out of a total of 1,240 entries, one Grand Prize winner and two Contest Winners Prize recipients were selected.
    • MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2025 – THE ISEKAI presented by KADOKAWA Webpage: mhwc.myanimelist.net/202507

    Grand Prize “Isekai’d with my dog, I'm not the hero?!” by Frettiko

    An average guy named Mitsuta is reincarnated into another world along with his pet dog, Toast. However, the goddess becomes utterly smitten with the adorable Toast and grants all of the hero’s bonuses to him instead. For a level 99 “Hero” Pomeranian, defeating monsters is a walk in the park. Meanwhile, his owner Mitsuta remains stuck at level 1... Constantly dragged along by the free-spirited Toast, Mitsuta gathers a group of quirky companions and runs an odd-jobs business, gradually carving out a place for himself in this new world. At this rate, they might even end up defeating the Demon King someday? A fluffy, feel-good comedy about a fun-filled isekai life with a beloved pet. Go read “Isekai’d with my dog, I'm not the hero?!” on Honeyfeed.

    Contest Winners Prize “HR in Another World: Building the Strongest Parties with my Appraisal Skill” by Kaorin

    Hiroyuki, an HR manager, is summoned to another world by a goddess. He has no combat ability whatsoever, but armed with the Divine Appraisal skill, which reveals hidden potential, he recruits allies and assembles the ultimate party. As Hiroyuki builds his team, however, the shadow of an assassin targeting him draws near... In a world far harsher than expected, can this hero’s party stand up to the Demon Lord’s army? A grand adventure begins as Hiroyuki uses his appraisal skills to save the world. Go read “HR in Another World: Building the Strongest Parties with my Appraisal Skill” on Honeyfeed.

    Contest Winners Prize “Drinking Buddies: Hangover In Another World!” by Literate_Manul

    Marcus and Gus are transported to another world while hungover. Desperate to impress an elf princess, they end up boasting that they will “defeat one of the Demon Lord’s generals.” By sheer chance, Marcus awakens to beer magic and starts blasting beer while shouting “Hop Missile!”, while Gus’s right arm, whose power he cannot consciously control, suddenly awakens... With zero ability and zero planning, but unmatched bravado, these two men launch into a wildly unpredictable isekai buddy comedy! Go read “Drinking Buddies: Hangover In Another World” on Honeyfeed.

    Overall Review by KADOKAWA’s Editorial Department

    KADOKAWA’s first English-language novel contest on Honeyfeed received 1,240 submissions, the highest number in the platform’s contest history. We are deeply honored by this response and delighted to see such strong interest from English-speaking creators in Japan’s light novel market. Following a rigorous selection process, one Grand Prize winner and two Contest Winners Prize recipients were selected. After initial voting by Honeyfeed users and volunteers, the final judging was conducted by Aneko Yusagi (author of The Rising of the Shield Hero) and editors from KADOKAWA. The Grand Prize winner, Isekai’d with My Dog, I’m Not the Hero?!, stood out for its catchy, approachable premise, making it easy to imagine on the shelves of Japanese bookstores. The novel delivers plenty of laugh-out-loud comedic moments, along with charming portrayals of Toast, the adorable dog. We were eager to read more about Toast’s exploits, his bond with the protagonist Mitsuta, and Mitsuta’s growth over the course of the story. The author, Frettiko, will receive a cash award of USD 5,000. The winning work will also be assigned a KADOKAWA editor and is scheduled for translation and publication in Japan, with a target release in 2027. The first Contest Winners Prize recipient, HR in Another World: Building the Strongest Parties with My Appraisal Skill, made effective use of the appraisal skill trope that has become a staple of the isekai genre, while capturing the distinctive feel of Japanese web novels. At the same time, its expansive setting evoked the scope of a large-scale open-world game. The careful portrayal of each character, along with story developments involving figures whose allegiance is unclear, added depth and originality to the narrative. The author, Kaorin, will receive a cash award of USD 3,000. The work will also be assigned a KADOKAWA editor and revised with the aim of translation and publication in Japan. The second Contest Winners Prize recipient, Drinking Buddies: Hangover in Another World!, is a lighthearted comedy that keeps the pages turning. Its one-of-a-kind tone, blending concepts like “beer magic” with a chunibyo-style demonic arm, creates a brand of absurd humor that is strangely compelling. The two protagonists, Marcus and Gus, drinking buddies from our world, are character types rarely seen in Japanese fiction and are likely to feel fresh and distinctive to Japanese readers. The author, Literate_Manul, will receive a cash award of USD 3,000. The work will also be assigned a KADOKAWA editor and revised with the aim of translation and publication in Japan. Going forward, KADOKAWA plans to continue hosting web novel contests in Japan and abroad to discover talented writers from around the world who share a passion for Japanese entertainment content.

    Comment from Aneko Yusagi (author of The Rising of the Shield Hero) on the Grand Prize-Winning Work

    Isekai’d with My Dog, I’m Not the Hero?! feels like a novel written with a strong understanding of Japanese light novels. The characters are comical, the pacing is brisk, and the story offers a genuinely light, comedic reading experience. I read it with excitement, eager to see what would unfold in the misadventures of this delightfully mismatched party.

    About MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2025 – THE ISEKAI presented by KADOKAWA

    Through this contest, KADOKAWA opened submissions worldwide for English-language isekai fantasy novels, looking for the next hit to follow in the footsteps of globally popular hits such as Overlord, Re:ZERO − Starting Life in Another World, The Rising of the Shield Hero, Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation, and Sword Art Online.

    About KADOKAWA’s Global UGC Content Development Project

    In recent years, Japanese anime has surged in popularity worldwide, with many hit titles originating from light novels. In parallel, overseas online novel platforms have seen a growing number of works influenced by Japanese light novels, becoming fertile ground for creators with global potential. In response, KADOKAWA launched the Global UGC Content Development Project in 2025 as part of its Global Business Acceleration Program, which supports new overseas-oriented business initiatives. Through this project, KADOKAWA aims to discover global talent from international novel submission platforms and publish their works in Japan and abroad to create new hit IPs. The MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2025 – THE ISEKAI presented by KADOKAWA represents the first step in this effort. As another initiative under the same project, KADOKAWA also held the “Japan Debut Showdown☆Fantasy Light Novel Contest” in 2025 on KadoKado, a novel submission platform operated by Kadokawa Taiwan Corporation that accepts submissions in Traditional Chinese. The announcement of the winning works is scheduled for June 2026. In addition, plans are underway to publish Why Kill? When Witches Can Be Tentacled!, a work submitted to Honeyfeed, as well as selected winning titles from the JNC Original Light Novel Contest hosted by M12 Media LLC.

    About Honeyfeed

    Honeyfeed is a leading writing platform that empowers authors to create, share, and engage with their original stories. With a vibrant community of readers and writers, Honeyfeed provides an immersive space for storytelling across various genres, including anime and manga-inspired narratives. For more about Honeyfeed, please visit honeyfeed.fm.

    About MyAnimeList (MAL)

    MyAnimeList is one of the world’s largest communities and databases for Japanese anime and manga, with 16 million registered members from 240 countries and regions worldwide. An indispensable site for tracking anime and manga progress, it holds over 1.2 billion records of viewing and reading big data. Founded in 2004, MyAnimeList has become a crucial source of information for overseas fans, especially among Generation Z in North America. For more about MyAnimeList, please visit myanimelist.net.

MyAnimeList and Honeyfeed Announce the Return of NOVELOUS Worlds for 2026, Powered by Shogakukan
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • MyAnimeList and Honeyfeed are proud to announce the return of NOVELOUS Worlds as part of the MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2026, inviting writers from around the world to craft original Rom-Com and Psychological Horror stories.
  • Powered by Shogakukan, this year’s contest offers aspiring authors the opportunity to reach new audiences by having their work featured on NOVELOUS, the official light novel reading app for North America.
  • Unlike traditional writing contests, NOVELOUS Worlds highlights more than just its winners. The top ten finalist novels will be showcased on the NOVELOUS app during the public voting period, allowing thousands of light novel fans across North America to discover emerging talent.

    • Contest Information

    Entry Fee: Free Writing Platform: Honeyfeed Voting Platform: NOVELOUS Novel Entry Period: February 16, 2026, at 20:00 EST – May 10, 2026, at 23:59 EDT Judges Voting Period: May 11 – June 28, 2026 Public Voting Period (Finals): June 29, 2026, at 21:00 EDT – July 27, 2026, at 23:59 EDT Winners Announced: August 12, 2026 Contest Prompts: Prompt 1: Rom-Com Prompt 2: Psychological Horror Prizes: - Most Voted “Rom-Com” Entry: US$3,000 - Most Voted “Psychological Horror” Entry: US$3,000 - Jury Choice Award (Across Both Prompts): US$3,000 Spotlight: All 10 finalist entries will be featured on the NOVELOUS app during the voting phase. NOVELOUS Worlds continues MyAnimeList and Honeyfeed’s mission to bridge global creators with the Japanese light novel industry, offering writers a platform to showcase their stories alongside professionally published works. For complete contest details, submission guidelines, and updates, please visit: mhwc.myanimelist.net/202602

    About NOVELOUS

    NOVELOUS is an app for reading Japanese light novels. While many people are already familiar with the countless anime and manga series born in Japan, light novels, which often serve as their source material, remain lesser-known. This is partly due to the lack of widespread translations. Through NOVELOUS, Shogakukan, one of Japan’s leading publishers, will introduce North American readers to light novels that have yet to gain wide recognition, offering translations directly from the source.

    About Honeyfeed

    Honeyfeed is a leading writing platform that empowers authors to create, share, and engage with their original stories. With a vibrant community of readers and writers, Honeyfeed provides an immersive space for storytelling across various genres, including anime and manga-inspired narratives. For more about Honeyfeed, please visit honeyfeed.fm.

    About MyAnimeList (MAL)

    MyAnimeList is one of the world’s largest communities and databases for Japanese anime and manga, with 16 million registered members from 240 countries and regions worldwide. An indispensable site for tracking anime and manga progress, it holds over 1.2 billion records of viewing and reading big data. Founded in 2004, MyAnimeList has become a crucial source of information for overseas fans, especially among Generation Z in North America. For more about MyAnimeList, please visit myanimelist.net.

item.title: majiko to Release New Song “Ribbon” in April as Opening Theme for The Food Diary of Miss Maid
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Singer-songwriter majiko, who has garnered over 200 million streams across Asia and more than 580,000 YouTube subscribers, has been chosen to perform the opening theme for the TV anime The Food Diary of Miss Maid, which will begin airing in April. A new artist photo has also been released.
  • The new song is titled “Ribbon” and is scheduled for digital release in April to coincide with the anime’s broadcast. A preview of the track can be heard in the anime’s newly released promotional video.
  • This will be majiko’s first anime tie-in since moving to Bandai Namco Music Live’s label UNIERA in July 2025. After releasing the EP GOLDEN JUNKIE last October and holding a solo concert in December, majiko continues to expand her activities in the music scene.

    • Comment From majiko

    I had the honor of writing a brand-new song titled “Ribbon” for the opening of The Food Diary of Miss Maid. When I read the story, I remember feeling my heart slowly warm, thinking, “What a gentle, heartwarming world this is...!” As I reflected on where I had felt this kind of warmth before, I realized it was in my interactions with all of you, my fans. “Ribbon” is a song I wrote by blending Suzume-chan’s bright way of finding happiness in everyday life with the many heartfelt feelings I’ve received from my fans. I would be happy if this song, along with the series, could softly tie itself into your daily lives as well.

    Product Information

    GOLDEN JUNKIE Now available on music streaming websites: lnk.to/GOLDEN_JUNKIE

    About majiko

    Since 2010, majiko has been posting cover songs on video-sharing platforms, gradually building a following in the online scene. She writes, composes, arranges, and illustrates her own work, showcasing her multifaceted talents across a range of creative activities. In recent years, she has held solo shows in China and Taiwan, and with over 200 million streams across Asia, her growing success is now drawing attention both regionally and worldwide. Official Website: majiko.net YouTube: youtube.com/user/majikoofficial X: twitter.com/majakoja Instagram: instagram.com/_majiko_ TikTok: tiktok.com/@majiko_official Facebook: facebook.com/majikoofficial Weibo: weibo.com/u/7053204102 BiliBili: space.bilibili.com/2024958074?spm_id_from=333.337.0.0 PINUPS artist: hpinupsartist.jp UNIERA: uniera-label.jp

Mrs. GREEN APPLE Drops “lulu.” Season 2 OP Theme for Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End with Surprise Music Video
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Mrs. GREEN APPLE released their new song “lulu.” today. Originally announced as the first track of Phase 3, a new chapter in the band’s career that began on New Year’s Day, the song has now been revealed as the opening theme for season 2 of the anime Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End, which begins airing on January 16.
  • A music video for “lulu.” was also surprise-released on Mrs. GREEN APPLE’s official YouTube channel. Ahead of this release, a YouTube livestream began at 10:00 p.m. on January 11 after only the stream URL was posted on social media, without prior explanation. The livestream ran for approximately two hours before transitioning directly into the premiere of the “lulu.” music video, with peak concurrent viewership exceeding 200,000.
  • Unlike Phase 2, when music videos were typically announced in advance, the release of “lulu.” took place without prior notice, marking an unpredictable start to Phase 3 for Mrs. GREEN APPLE.
    • https://youtu.be/MjeiIal1ZR0

    Comment from Motoki Ohmori (Vo/Gt)

    I’ve loved the series since the original manga, so it’s an honor to be involved. “lulu.” is a song about life, treasured things, memories, and will being passed from one person to another, flowing steadily into today and on to tomorrow. It also conveys the strength to move forward while carrying one’s hometown in one’s heart. As a fan of Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End, I’m already very much looking forward to what this season will depict. I hope you’ll enjoy “lulu.” alongside the series. https://youtu.be/RH-FcW94z00

    Song Information

    Mrs. GREEN APPLE Digital Single Title: lulu. OP theme for Season 2 of Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Release Date: January 12, 2026 lnk.to/MGA_lulu_0112

    About Mrs. GREEN APPLE

    Motoki Ohmori (Vo/Gt) instagram.com/motoki_ohmori_mga Hiroto Wakai (Gt) instagram.com/hiloto_wakai_mga Ryoka Fujisawa (Key) instagram.com/ryoka_fujisawa_mga Mrs. GREEN APPLE was formed in 2013 and made their major debut in 2015 with the mini-album Variety. After releasing their best album 5 in July 2020, the band temporarily suspended activities before resuming in March 2022 following a hiatus of approximately one year and eight months. Their return was marked by the comeback concert “Utopia” and the release of the mini-album Unity on July 8. Later that year, they released “Soranji,” the theme song for the film Fragments of the Last Will. In 2023, their 10th anniversary year, Mrs. GREEN APPLE released the album ANTENNA, staged their largest arena tour to date along with their first dome shows, won the Japan Record Award with “Que Sera Sera,” and made their debut appearance on NHK’s Kohaku Uta Gassen with “Dance Hall.” In 2024, they released “Nachtmusik,” the theme song for the film Silent Love, followed by “Lilac,” the opening theme for the TV anime Oblivion Battery. Across major streaming platforms, 31 of the band’s songs have each surpassed 100 million plays. Among them, “Ao to Natsu” has exceeded 900 million plays, while multiple tracks including “Tenbyou no Uta (feat. Sonoko Inoue),” “Dance Hall,” and “Lilac” have surpassed 800 million. According to Billboard JAPAN and Oricon, Mrs. GREEN APPLE is the first artist in history to exceed 11 billion cumulative domestic streams across all songs. In 2025, marking the 10th anniversary of their debut, the band released their anniversary best album 10 on July 8, along with seven new songs, including the opening theme for the second cour of season 2 of the TV anime The Apothecary Diaries. They won three titles on the Oricon Yearly Rankings 2025 and seven titles on the Billboard JAPAN 2025 Year-End Charts. In addition, their anniversary best album 10 surpassed 1 million copies in cumulative sales, achieving million-seller status on the December 22 edition of the Oricon Daily Album Ranking. item.title: Rico Sasaki Announces Full-Length Album RI PATHOS, Featuring Ten All-New Tracks
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Singer and voice actress Rico Sasaki has announced that she will release her full-length album RI PATHOS on June 3, 2026. Featuring ten all-new songs, the album reflects her journey to date and the future she is moving toward as an artist.
  • Each track is built around themes closely connected to Sasaki herself, with the album as a whole shaped by the choices she has made and the people she has encountered along the way, including detours and unexpected turns.
  • The limited first-press edition will include a bonus track, “Tezukuri no Uta,” the first song for which Sasaki wrote both the lyrics and music herself.
  • In addition, tracks from the album will be released digitally over five consecutive months ahead of the full release. The first advance track, “Maru de Matryoshka,” is now available on streaming services.

    • Comment from Rico Sasaki

    The full album RI PATHOS represents the path I have walked so far. Even when things didn’t go smoothly, moments of uncertainty or stopping to move at my own pace were all important parts of that journey. I believe the time I spent taking those detours was necessary to connect with people I could never have met by moving straight ahead. Driven by passion, this album captures, in new songs, the moments when my soul was deeply moved. Through the five months of advance digital releases and the album’s release, I would be happy if you would continue walking this path together with me.

    Streaming Information

    Rico Sasaki's Profile

    Born November 10 Akita Prefecture Rico Sasaki loved music and singing from a young age and grew up surrounded by various musical influences. In her fifth year of elementary school, she won the leading role in the musical Annie from among 9,000 applicants. This led to an awakening in singing and acting, and she enrolled in a high school with a specialized music program, where she majored in vocal music. Despite her petite stature, her voice resonates with a soulful quality that surprises many. She is also currently active as a voice actress. Some of her main roles include Misumi Uika/Doloris in BanG Dream! Ave Mujica, Mewi in Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf!, Daia Nijinosaki in Kiratto Pri Chan, Ayako Yamada in Kageki Shojo!!, and Chisa Sasuga in World Dai Star. Based on the TE-V1R, this special edition features an original design inspired by the film and over 200 newly recorded voice lines.

item.title: REIRIE Reveals New Artist Photos and “AISHITEYO” Music Video Ahead of Major-Label Debut EP Amethyst
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • REIRIE, a two-member unit formed in 2023 by Rei Kuromiya and Rie Kaneko, will make their major-label debut with the release of their first EP, Amethyst, on January 28, 2026, via MoooD Records, a label under Bandai Namco Music Live. Ahead of the release, the group has unveiled new artist photos, the EP’s jacket artwork, and the music video for “AISHITEYO,” one of the tracks featured on Amethyst.
  • The new visuals feature a black-and-white palette set against the theme color of amethyst. Styling that layers contrasting materials such as lace, fur, and leather reflects REIRIE’s balance of stillness and movement. Their delicate yet sharp demeanor leaves a strong impression as the start of a new chapter.
  • Amethyst will be released in three editions: the REI Edition, the RIE Edition, and the Standard Edition. The REI Edition includes a Blu-ray featuring footage from the free live show “JAM,” held on September 12 at Kabukicho Tower Stage, while the RIE Edition comes with a Blu-ray of the Tokyo performance from REIRIE Live Tour 2025 -BaD＝DoLL-, held on October 26. As a first-press bonus, all editions will include one randomly selected trading card from a set of six.
  • The EP comprises five tracks rooted in guitar rock, incorporating emotional, alternative, and R&B elements that highlight the duo’s expressive range and vocal contrast. The advance digital single “BaD＝DoLL,” composed by Yuki Tsujimura and MEGMETAL, delivers an emotionally charged rock sound. “AISHITEYO,” by the same creative team, channels raw emotion and heightened drama, further brought to life in the music video released today.
  • The EP also features “Holy Brighters,” which portrays heroism that moves forward despite doubt and anxiety, “Not Philosophy,” which explores strength and love through emotion rather than words, and “Contact,” a soulful R&B-based track that affirms even pain and inner conflict.
  • In addition, REIRIE will launch their nationwide tour, “REIRIE Live Tour 2026 -Amethyst-,” in February 2026. Spanning 12 cities, the tour will be the largest of the group’s career to date.

Maaya Sakamoto’s New Single “Tokei” Now Available on Digital Platforms!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Maaya Sakamoto just released her newest digital single “Tokei”, which has also been chosen as the theme song for the final chapter of popular mobile RPG Fate/Grand Order. The multi-talented singer, voice actress, actress, songwriter and essayist released her 30th anniversary album M30~Your Best~ in October 2025.
  • “Tokei” is the sixth track in the Fate/Grand Order series, following “Shikisai”, “Gyakko”, “Kuuhaku”, “Yakudo” and “Dokuhaku”. Maaya Sakamoto wrote the lyrics herself and composed the theme song for the conclusion of the series she has been a part of for ten years.
  • The theme song is an emotional track depicting “hope for the future”, setting it apart from previous theme songs from the FGO series. Ryo Eguchi arranged the song, a member of la la larks who helped compose and arrange “Shikisai” and the arrangement for “Gyakko”.
  • The result is a richly-layered track that is fitting for the final chapter of the FGO series, created by a team who know the series by heart.
  • The music video for “Tokei” premiered December 29 and features an animated style, numerous characters from the Fate/Grand Order series, and visuals that complement the grand finale of the work and its theme song.
    • https://youtu.be/BGURhEDsAnw

    Release information

    Artist: Maaya Sakamoto Title: Tokei (theme song for final chapter of Mobile RPG Fate/Grand Order) Date: December 28, 2025 Lyrics and composition: Maaya Sakamoto, Arrangement: Ryo Eguchi, String arrangement: Ryo Eguchi and miri

    Streaming information

    Available on select music streaming services and major music download platforms such as iTunes Store, Rekochoku and mora December 28, 2025! Streaming services: Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, LINE MUSIC, Amazon Music, Deezer, AWA, Rakuten Music, KKBOX, Qobuz Watch the music video on Apple Music, YouTube Music, LINE MUSIC, and U-NEXT.

    About Maaya Sakamoto

    Born in Tokyo, she began her career as a child actress at the age of eight. She made her CD debut in 1996 with the single “Yakusoku wa Iranai.” Following her 2011 album You Can’t Catch Me, which topped the Oricon chart, she began actively collaborating with a wide range of other artists and musicians. Since her 2013 album Singer-Songwriter, she has also been composing music for other artists. In 2019, she released her 30th single “Uchuu no Kioku” (produced by Ringo Sheena) and her 10th original album Kyou Dake no Ongaku. In 2020, she released her 25th anniversary album Single Collection+ Achikochi and the digital single “Yakudo,” which topped the Oricon chart. In July 2021, her radio program “Vitamin M,” which she had been hosting for 20 years, reached its 1,000th broadcast and entered its 21st year. In May 2022, she released the double tie-up single “Sumire / Kotoba ni Dekinai,” with music written and arranged by Shigeru Kishida. In October 2025, she released her latest album celebrating her 30th anniversary as an artist, M30~Your Best~. To date, she has released 36 singles and 11 full albums. In addition to writing her own original songs, she has also written lyrics for other artists, including Kinki Kids’ “Hikari no Kehai,” Mamoru Miyano’s “Toumei,” and Walküre’s “Kaze wa Yokoku Naku Fuku,” and has published her own lyrics book Shishu (Kadokawa). She won the 38th Kazuo Kikuta Theater Award for her performance as Jerusha in the musical Daddy-Long-Legs. As of December 12, she is currently appearing in the latest production of Daddy-Long-Legs at Hibiya Theatre Crea as Jerusha for the first time in five years. Her latest essay collection Manpukuron - Asu ni Kaburitsuke (Kadokawa) has also garnered attention. In addition to her singing career, she is active as a voice actress, actress, lyricist, essayist, and radio personality. Her fresh and vibrant voice is loved by fans not only in Japan but also around the world.
